_help: 스토리 대사 영어판. 키 = 한국어 원문, 값 = 번역. 원문을 고치면 그 문장은 번역이 없어 한국어로 나간다. config/rtshop/story_lang/en_us.json 에 같은 형식으로 넣으면 덮어쓴다.
Guard the flame, guard the seals. …Well, apprentice, what have you come to learn today?
The Chronicle doesn't lie. It's just that… someone tore pages out of it.
지도는 발로 그리는 거다. 신발 끈은 단단히 맸나?: Maps are drawn with your feet. Are your boots laced tight?
서장 폭풍 뒤의 부두 (1/3): Prologue: The Pier After the Storm (1/3)
폭풍을 뚫고 들어온 배, 맞죠? 어서 오세요, 폭풍 조사대 여러분! 저는: You came in on the ship that beat the storm, right? Welcome, Storm Survey Corps! I'm Morris, the guide. The Ember Order called you from across the sea because we're short of hands. First let me show you how to live in Vestalia. Follow the 'Path of the Novice Adventurer' to the end.
Finish every step of Morris's 'Path of the Novice Adventurer'.
잘하셨어요! 이제 베스탈리아 사람이에요. 은행도, 상점도, 땅도 여러분: Well done! You're one of Vestalia's people now. The bank, the shops, the land — they're all yours. Oh, and the Order was looking for surveyors.
폭풍 조사대, 베스탈리아에 닿다: The Storm Survey Corps reaches Vestalia
서장 폭풍 뒤의 부두 (2/3): Prologue: The Pier After the Storm (2/3)
네가 이번 배의 조사대원이냐. 탐험대장 로란이다. 조사대는 칼만으로 굴러: So you're one of the surveyors off this ship. I'm Roran, expedition captain. The Corps doesn't run on swords alone. The smith forges blades, the cook makes soup, the fisher reads the sea. Go see Albert, the job guide, and choose your path.
Talk to Albert the job guide and come back.
좋다. 네 몫을 하는 놈이 조사대에 남는다. 이번 배에서 몇이나 남을지는: Good. The ones who pull their weight stay in the Corps. How many from this ship will stay… we'll see.
서장 폭풍 뒤의 부두 (3/3): Prologue: The Pier After the Storm (3/3)
폭풍 조사대의 새 얼굴이로군. 잿불 수도회 장로 에르윈일세. 수도회 일을: A new face in the Storm Survey Corps. I am Erwin, elder of the Order of the Embers. To work for the Order you must take the apprentice's oath. Fetch the oath from Archivist Isabel, then recite it before me. "Guard the flame, guard the seals."
Get the oath scroll from Isabel the archivist.
\"불을 지키고, 봉인을 지킨다.\" …좋네. 이 불씨도 받게. 조사대원: "Guard the flame, guard the seals." …Good. Take this ember as well. Every surveyor receives one. Get some sleep early tonight. On the first night, everyone… dreams the same dream.
Archivist Isabel: You're one of the surveyors from this ship, right? Here's the oath.
기록관 이사벨: 서약은 세 줄이에요. 첫째, 불을 지킨다. 둘째, 봉인을: Archivist Isabel: The oath has three lines. One, guard the flame. Two, guard the seals. Three… the third line has been erased.
기록관 이사벨: 이 서약서, 우리 어머니가 베껴 쓴 거예요. 어머니도 기: Archivist Isabel: My mother copied this oath by hand. She was an archivist too. Fifteen years ago… oh, never mind. Take it to the Elder.
꿈속의 불타는 기사: The Burning Knight in the Dream
불씨를 쥔 자들아. 너희는 몇이냐.\n…많구나. 그래도 아직은, 오지 마:
You who hold the embers. How many are you?
…So many. Even so — not yet. Do not come.
조사대원님, 부탁이 있어요. 수도회의 「잿빛 연대기」예요. 천 년 전 일: Surveyor, I have a favor to ask. This is the Order's Ashen Chronicle. It tells how, a thousand years ago, seven kings divided the world's fire and sealed it away. But look. These pages didn't fall out from age — they were cut out with a blade. Fifteen years ago my mother Elena, the archivist before me, went out to find them and never came back. Her last note says: 'The first page, beside a ruined portal.'
무너진 차원문을 찾아가 보세요. (조사대 나침반을 쓰면 방향을 알려 줘요: Find a ruined portal. (A Survey Compass will point the way.)
그을린 종이… 첫 페이지예요! \"일곱은 불을 가두었고, 불은 한 사람을: Scorched paper… it's the first page! "The seven imprisoned the fire, and the fire imprisoned one man." And there's an ink dot in the corner. That's the mark my mother left wherever she found something. She made it this far.
기록관 이사벨, 끝까지 읽기 위하여: Archivist Isabel, to read it to the end
흙 속의 잉크 점: An Ink Dot in the Dirt
어머니의 메모를 다시 읽어 봤어요. '오래된 길의 폐허, 항아리 조각에: I read my mother's note again. 'Ruins on the old road, left a mark on a pot shard.' Trail ruins. If you brush away the dirt, old pottery shards turn up. One of them should carry her ink dot.
흔적 유적을 찾아 붓으로 도기 조각을 파내 가져오세요. (붓은 깃털·구리: Find trail ruins, dig up pottery sherds with a brush and bring them back. (A brush is made from a feather, copper and a stick.)
…이 조각이에요. 잉크 점 옆에 날짜가 있어요. 열다섯 해 전 봄. 그리: …This is the one. There's a date beside the ink dot. Spring, fifteen years ago. And a name: 'Dowin, miner.' My mother wasn't alone. She had a guide.
광부 도윈? 그 이름은 안다. 열다섯 해 전 폐광에 들어갔다가 나오지 못: Dowin the miner? I know that name. Went into an abandoned mine fifteen years ago and never came out. The collapsed tunnels crawl with cave spiders. They're poisonous, so bring milk. If you find so much as his lantern, the archivist will be glad.
Find an abandoned mineshaft and kill 6 cave spiders.
갱도 끝 침목에 칼로 새긴 글씨가 있었다고? '엘레나 씨는 사막으로. 나: Words carved into a sleeper at the end of the tunnel? 'Miss Elena went on to the desert. I stay here. Spiders blocked the way.' …Dowin was a guide to the last. He sent Elena on ahead and stayed behind alone.
A guide isn't the one who goes first. It's the one who stays last.
모래 속의 두 번째 장: The Second Page in the Sand
도윈이 엘레나를 사막으로 보냈다. 사막 피라미드 아래에 연대기의 두 번째: Dowin sent Elena to the desert. Must mean the Chronicle's second page lies beneath a desert pyramid. Below it, it's pressure-plate traps everywhere. Watch your step.
\"사막의 왕은 모래 속의 눈을 받았고, 서리의 왕은 얼음 속의 눈을 받: "The King of the Desert received the Eye in the sand, and the King of Frost the Eye in the ice." …Two of the Seven Eyes. But something's off. Someone opened the chests before us. There were footprints in the sand. Ahead of us.
발자국은 쇠뇌 화살과 함께 북쪽으로 이어졌다. 약탈자다. 종이 쪼가리를: The footprints went north, along with crossbow bolts. Pillagers. Why would they collect scraps of paper? Because someone pays them to. Find their outpost and take down the patrol.
Find a pillager outpost and defeat 8 pillagers.
A pouch from the captain's pack. There's gold inside… but I've never seen coins like these. They're not from any kingdom. They're grey. Show them at the town hall. Those people can smell money.
조사대원님, 그 금화를 보여 주시겠습니까. 시청에는 지금까지 베스탈리아를: Surveyor, may I see that coin. The town hall keeps a specimen of every currency that has ever passed through Vestalia.
Show the grey coin to Haru the town clerk.
견본과 맞는 것이 없습니다. 그리고 한 가지 더. 시청 게시판에 이름 없: Nothing in the samples matches. And one more thing. An anonymous bounty was once posted on the town hall board. 'Pages of the Ashen Chronicle, ten grey coins apiece.' Whoever posted it isn't on record. The same bounty went up fifteen years ago, in the spring.
Haru the Town Clerk: A grey coin… let me open the sample drawer.
시청 서기 하루: 왕국 금화, 해적 금화, 피글린의 금 조각까지… 없습니: Haru the Town Clerk: Royal gold, pirate gold, even piglin gold nuggets… nothing. Coins like this aren't on record.
시청 서기 하루: 뒷면의 그림을 보십시오. 망토를 두른 사람입니다. 회색: Haru the Town Clerk: Look at the image on the back. A man wrapped in a cloak. A grey cloak.
어머니의 동행이 한 명 더 있었어요. 지도 제작자 펠릭스. 어머니 일행이: My mother had one more companion. Felix the mapmaker. They spent a winter in an igloo in the snowlands. But under the igloo floor there's a cellar… and rumor says a zombie villager is locked down there. If that's Felix… they say a potion of weakness and a golden apple can bring him back.
Find an igloo and cure a zombie villager.
되돌아온 주민이 떨리는 목소리로 그랬다고요. \"엘레나 씨는… 잉크를 구: The villager you brought back said, voice shaking: "Miss Elena… went to the swamp witch for ink. Invisible ink." It was Felix. Fifteen years in that cellar… I'm glad. I'm truly glad.
엘레나 씨는 말했소. '내가 돌아오지 않으면, 딸에게 끝까지 읽으라고 전: Miss Elena said: 'If I don't come back, tell my daughter to read to the end.'
보이지 않는 잉크요. 어머니의 일지 중 몇 장은 백지였어요. 그 잉크로: Invisible ink. Some pages of my mother's journal were blank. She wrote them with that ink. The witch in the swamp hut knows how to make it. You can't reason with a witch… so defeat her and find the ink jar. And we'll need glow ink sacs to make more.
늪지대 오두막을 찾아 마녀를 쓰러뜨리고, 발광 먹물 주머니 4개를 가져오: Find a swamp hut, defeat the witch, and bring 4 glow ink sacs.
잉크 단지에 적힌 조리법이에요. '블레이즈 불빛 아래에서만 드러난다.': There's a recipe written on the ink jar. 'Revealed only under blaze light.' …My mother wrote her journal that way on purpose. So no one could read it in secret. But there's violet ink dried at the bottom of the jar. It's not the witch's ink. All it says is that it's the ink 'the people in the mirror' use.
블레이즈 불빛이 필요하다고? 마침 잘됐네. 요즘 밤마다 남쪽 하늘이 붉게: You need blaze light? Good timing. Have you seen the southern sky turn red every night lately? It's a sign the Nether's fire is seething. Open a portal, go to the Nether and look at the sky. And bring back plenty of blaze rods on the way.
Enter the Nether, look at the sky, and bring back 4 blaze rods.
…그랬군. 하늘이 불타고 있었단 말이지. (장로가 장갑 낀 손을 꽉 쥔다: …I see. So the sky was burning. (The Elder clenches his gloved hand.) Give the rods to Isabel. The archive's lantern was the one Elena used to keep lit.
The fire is trying to break past me.
You who hold the embers — not yet. Do not come.
꺼지지 않는 등불: The Lamp That Never Went Out
블레이즈 막대와 잉크가 다 모였어요. 기록고 맨 안쪽에 어머니의 등불이: We have the blaze rods and the ink. My mother's lantern is at the very back of the archive. It hasn't been lit once since she disappeared. …Will you come with me? I can't walk into that room alone.
Light the archive's lantern together with Archivist Isabel.
My mother hid the remaining pages at 'the three ends from which no one returns.' The burning fortress, the city where sound dies, and the end of the void. So that whoever was after the pages couldn't follow her there. …She walked all three ends. I'll walk them too.
기록관 이사벨: 이 방이에요. 어머니의 책상은 그대로예요. 먼지만 쌓였죠: Archivist Isabel: This is the room. Her desk is just as she left it. Only dust has piled up.
Archivist Isabel: Put the rod in the lantern. …It's lit.
Archivist Isabel: Look! Letters are rising on the blank pages.
기록관 이사벨: \"이사벨에게. 이 글을 읽는다면 나는 돌아가지 못한 것: Archivist Isabel: "To Isabel. If you are reading this, I could not come home. I hid the pages at the three ends."
기록관 이사벨: \"불타는 요새의 검은 별 곁에, 소리 없는 도시의 문: Archivist Isabel: "Beside the black star in the burning fortress, before the gate of the soundless city, beneath the dragon at the end of the void."
불타는 요새 · 소리 없는 도시 · 허공의 끝: The Burning Fortress · The Soundless City · The End of the Void
네더의 잊힌 도시: The Forgotten City of the Nether
엘레나의 일지에 네더 지도가 있다. 버섯이 탑처럼 자란 숲 너머, 누군가: Elena's journal has a map of the Nether. Past a forest where mushrooms grow like towers, someone built a city. Elena says she found a 'reviving pig statue' there and it kept her alive. Fire serpents called Nether Nagas guard the city. They spit poisoned darts, so keep your shield up.
Find a Nether city and defeat 3 Nether Nagas.
석상 받침대에 엘레나의 잉크 점이 있었다고? …그 사람, 네더에서도 꼼꼼: Elena's ink dot was on the statue's pedestal? …Thorough even in the Nether, that woman. The inscription under the statue: 'The black star sleeps in the fortress. When three heads gather, it wakes.'
엘레나가 지난 길을 따라가면 네더의 정글이 나온다. 정글 사원에 덩굴에: Follow Elena's path and you reach the Nether's jungle. Vine-wrapped skeletons live in the jungle temple. Elena mined rubies there and made a key for the road to the fortress. We take the same road.
네더 정글 사원을 찾고, 정글 해골을 6마리 물리치고, 네더 루비 2개를: Find a Nether jungle temple, defeat 6 jungle skeletons, and bring back 2 Nether rubies.
There's light trapped inside the ruby. Elena must have lit the fortress dark with these. Now we head to the fortress. To where the black star sleeps.
요새다. 위더 해골들이 지킨다. 놈들의 머리 셋과 영혼 모래 넷이 있으면: The fortress. Wither skeletons guard it. Three of their skulls and four soul sand wake the black star. Elena's page is in that star's heart. …But we have a problem. The cut from a skeleton's blade is withering black. My leg won't obey me. Milk will draw the poison out. Bring the materials and a bucket of milk. I'll hold on here.
네더 요새를 찾고, 위더 해골 머리 3개와 영혼 모래 4개, 그리고 탐험: Find a Nether fortress and bring 3 wither skeleton skulls, 4 soul sand, and 1 bucket of milk to save the captain.
(로란이 우유를 들이켜고 숨을 몰아쉰다.) …살았다. 엘레나는 혼자서 이: (Roran gulps down the milk and gasps for breath.) …I'll live. Elena crossed this fortress alone. With no one to hand her milk. We have the materials. Let's use the Order's Memory Gate. Beyond that gate, only you and your party fight.
기억의 문을 열어라. 검은 별, 위더다. 놈은 하늘에서 해골 탄막을 퍼붓: Open the Memory Gate. The black star — the Wither. It rains skull barrages from the sky, fires beams, and possesses the undead to make them its servants. You can bat the flying skulls back at it. Block its charge with a shield. Don't stop moving.
Open the Memory Gate and defeat the Wither.
As the star shattered, a scorched sheet of paper fell. "Fire devours names. So we write names down." …Just like Elena. Take it to the archivist. If she cries, pretend you didn't see.
The first end. Wake the black star.
Fire devours names.
So we write names down.
Surveyor! Trouble. There are pillager patrols all over the eastern fields — not one or two. Some are even leading huge beasts. They're heading for Vestalia. Please stop the ones out in front!
막았어요! 붙잡힌 약탈자가 그랬대요. 선장 카스의 부하들이 훔친 물건을: You stopped them! A captured pillager talked. Captain Kass's men hide their loot in the catacombs underground. And… someone already knew the black star had fallen.
카스 놈들은 훔친 걸 지하 묘지에 숨긴다. 죽은 자들 사이라야 아무도 안: Kass's lot hide what they steal in the catacombs. Among the dead, nobody goes digging, they say. Find the zombie-infested catacombs and find out what they're after.
Find the catacombs underground and defeat 10 zombies.
관 위에 카스의 쪽지가 있더군. '오늘 밤, 기록고. 엘레나의 일지 뒷장: There was a note from Kass on a coffin. 'Tonight, the archive. Bring the back pages of Elena's journal. The Grey Cloak takes them in person.' …Tonight? Get back there right now!
조사대원님! 늦었어요, 기록고가… 약탈자들이 불을 질렀어요! 연기 때문에: Surveyor! We're too late, the archive is… the pillagers set it on fire! I can't see through the smoke. My mother's records are still on the shelves… and over there — Mia, the apprentice archivist, has collapsed! We can't save both!
Enter the burning archive and go to Isabel the archivist.
…불은 꺼졌어요. 무엇을 먼저 구했는지는 당신이 골랐어요. 둘 다 옳은: …The fire's out. You chose what to save first. Both were the right choice. But Kass took the back pages of my mother's journal. They say he went to the undead fortress. He'll hand them to the Grey Cloak there.
기록관 이사벨: 이쪽이에요! 서가 쪽으로 불이 번지고 있어요!: Archivist Isabel: This way! The fire's spreading toward the shelves!
기록관 이사벨: 저기, 견습 기록관 미아가 쓰러져 있어요. 그런데 서가에: Archivist Isabel: Over there — Mia, the apprentice, is down. But the shelves hold my mother's records…
기록관 이사벨: 시간이 없어요. 조사대원님이 정해 주세요!: Archivist Isabel: There's no time. You decide, surveyor!
Dive into the burning shelves and save the records.
Drag the fallen apprentice archivist out first.
카스는 소환사다. 죽은 자를 부리는 놈답게 땅 밑의 언데드 요새를 거처로: Kass is a conjurer. As befits a man who commands the dead, he made the undead fortress underground his lair. We have to strike before the back pages reach the Grey Cloak. Skeleton archers stand in every corridor. Clear the way. If you see the Grey Cloak… don't chase him. Not yet.
Find the undead fortress underground and defeat 10 skeletons.
No Grey Cloak. But the innermost room reeked of a conjurer's circle. Fight him in the open and he'll pour out vexes. Let's drag him through the Memory Gate.
선장 카스. 기억의 문을 열어 놈만 끌어내라. 그 문 너머에선 너와 네: Captain Kass. Open the Memory Gate and pull him out alone. Beyond that gate, only you and your party fight. Watch for the fangs rising from the floor.
Open the Memory Gate and defeat Kass, the pillager captain (Evoker).
카스의 짐이다. 일지 뒷장… 그리고 이건 지도다. 낡았다. 스무 해는 됐: Kass's pack. The back pages of the journal… and this is a map. Old. Twenty years, I'd say. …Wait. This signature. Roran, Kael. That's my name. This is my expedition's map.
일지 뒷장에 두 번째 끝이 적혀 있어요. '땅 밑 깊은 어둠, 소리가 사: The second end is written in the back pages. 'Deep dark underground, the city where sound dies. I buried a page before the gate.' An ancient city. Step on a sculk sensor and the Warden wakes. Walk crouched. And… rumor says excavators are mining souls in the city.
Find an ancient city and defeat 3 excavators and 2 flame constructs.
굴착자들이 캐던 건 영혼이었다고요? 도시 한가운데 거대한 문 쪽으로 나르: The excavators were mining souls? Carrying them toward a huge gate in the middle of the city? My mother's page is in front of that gate. And inside the gate… something is growing.
어머니는 도시의 메아리 조각에 목소리를 남겼대요. 일지에 그렇게 적혀 있: My mother left her voice in the city's echo shards. That's what her journal says. 'An echo never forgets what it heard.' Please gather the shards. I want to… hear her voice.
(조각들이 서로 부딪히며 희미한 목소리를 낸다.) \"…이사벨, 연대기를: (The shards knock together and give off a faint voice.) "…Isabel, don't try to gather the whole Chronicle. Once it is whole, someone will use it." …That's my mother's voice. After fifteen years.
이사벨, 연대기를 다 모으려 하지 마라.\n다 모이면 누군가 그것을 쓴다:
Isabel, don't try to gather the whole Chronicle.
Once it is whole, someone will use it.
큰일이다. 기록관이 어머니 목소리를 더 듣겠다고 혼자 고대 도시로 내려갔: Trouble. The archivist went down into the ancient city alone to hear more of her mother's voice. When a sculk shrieker sounds, the Warden wakes. One noise and it's over. Stay crouched, slip between the sensors and bring the archivist back. Do not run.
고대 도시의 스컬크 감지기 곁을 웅크려 지나가 기록관을 데려와라. (발전: Crouch past a sculk sensor in the ancient city and bring the archivist back. (Advancement 'Sneak 100')
(이사벨이 떨리는 손으로 메아리 조각을 쥐고 있다.) …죄송해요. 어머니: (Isabel clutches an echo shard with trembling hands.) …I'm sorry. I heard my mother's voice from inside the gate. But it wasn't her. Something was imitating her voice. The thing inside the gate.

\"불을 나누면, 언젠가 누군가 다시 모은다.\"\n여덟 번째 왕 곁에:
"Divide the fire, and one day someone will gather it again."
At the eighth king's side stands an apprentice in a grey cloak.

다음 봉인일세. 이번에는 탐험대장 로란(이)가 함께 가겠다는군. 봉인 주: The next seal. This time Captain Roran says he'll go with you. Clear out the guardian's servants around the seal first. When the seal's Eye is revealed, show it to me.
Find the Machine That Saw the End and defeat the monsters there.
끝을 본 기계: The Machine That Saw the End
제 4 장 · 끝을 본 기계: Chapter Four · The Machine That Saw the End
기계의 나라는 미래를 계산하다가 스스로 멈췄다더군. 마지막 계산 결과가: They say the kingdom of machines stopped itself while calculating the future. Its final result was 'the end.'
끝을 본 기계 — 사냥하는 기계: The Machine That Saw the End — The Hunting Machine
Something deep in the factory is stalking us. The Prowler. A hunting machine. It trails the expedition and picks us off one by one. I'll be the bait. Bring it down while it chases me. …This time I'm not the one staying behind. I know you'll come.
Defeat the Prowler in the ancient factory.
(Roran laughs, catching his breath.) So this is how Kael felt twenty years ago. Believing someone will come from behind. …Not bad.

봉인의 수호자 하빈저(이)가 깨어났네. 기억의 문을 열어 쓰러뜨리게. 혼: The seal's guardian, the Harbinger, has awakened. Open the Memory Gate and bring it down. If it's too much alone, gather your comrades.
Open the Memory Gate and defeat the Harbinger.
하빈저의 마지막 예언이 울렸다. \"마지막 문을 여는 것은 불씨를 쥔 자: The Harbinger's last prophecy rang out. "Those who hold the embers will open the last gate. The hand that guides them wears a glove."
Its missiles track you. Circle behind the pillars.
The machine saw the end.
And standing at that end… is you.
심연의 수호자 — 찾아가기: Guardian of the Deep — Finding It
다음 봉인일세. 이번에는 어부 오스카(이)가 함께 가겠다는군. 봉인 주변: The next seal. This time Oscar the fisher says he'll go with you. Clear out the guardian's servants around the seal first. When the seal's Eye is revealed, show it to me.
Find the Guardian of the Deep and defeat the monsters there.
제 4 장 · 심연의 수호자: Chapter Four · Guardian of the Deep
바다 밑 도시의 사람들도 바다를 정직하다고 믿었겠지. 그런데 누가 그들의: The people of the city beneath the sea must have believed the sea was honest too. But someone took their Eye.
심연의 수호자 — 때 이른 각성: Guardian of the Deep — Premature Awakening
이보게, 도시 한가운데서 딥링 사제들이 노래를 하고 있네. 리바이어던을: Listen, the deepling priests are singing in the heart of the city. They're trying to wake the Leviathan before its time. If it wakes, the sea may freeze again. Stop the priests and the brutes guarding them. The sea… has only just thawed.
Defeat 2 deepling priests and 2 deepling brutes in the sunken city.
노래가 그쳤군. 바다가 조용해졌어. …사제들 목에 회색 금화가 걸려 있었: The singing has stopped. The sea's gone quiet. …Grey coins hung around the priests' necks? So those coins reached all the way to the bottom of the sea.
심연의 수호자 — 리바이어던: Guardian of the Deep — The Leviathan
The seal's guardian, the Leviathan, has awakened. Open the Memory Gate and bring it down. If it's too much alone, gather your comrades.
Open the Memory Gate and defeat the Leviathan.
리바이어던이 눈을 감았다. 천 년 만에 처음으로. 오스카가 조용히 모자를: The Leviathan closed its eyes. For the first time in a thousand years. Oscar quietly took off his hat.
Out of the water it can't use its strength. Drag it to the shore.
바다 밑 도시는 눈을 빼앗기고 울었다.\n빼앗은 자는 회색 망토를 입고:
The city beneath the sea wept when its Eye was taken.
The one who took it wore a grey cloak.
다섯 번째 봉인은 허공의 땅, 무너진 성채에 있네. 그런데 성채는 허공의: The fifth seal is in the land of the void, in a ruined citadel. But the citadel hides in the void's mist. Grind a lens from the shell of the giant crab in the amethyst nest and you can see past the mist. Find the nest and bring down the crab.
Find the amethyst nest underground and defeat the amethyst crab.
Excellent. Through this lens… I can see it. The citadel that once held eight thrones. (The Elder gazes into the lens a long time. His hand shakes.)
빈 왕좌의 문지기 — 찾아가기: Gatekeeper of the Empty Throne — Finding It
허공의 땅으로 가게. 렌즈가 가리키는 폐허 성채로. 엔더맙테라 떼를 정리: Go to the land of the void. To the ruined citadel the lens points to. Clear the swarms of endermapteras and enter the citadel.
Find the ruined citadel in the End and defeat 8 endermapteras.
왕좌실의 여덟 번째 자리에 긁힌 이름이 있었다고? …읽지 말게. 읽을 수: A name scratched into the eighth seat in the throne room? …Don't read it. You won't be able to.
제 4 장 · 빈 왕좌의 문지기: Chapter Four · Gatekeeper of the Empty Throne
빈 왕좌의 문지기 — 공허의 골렘: Gatekeeper of the Empty Throne — The Void Golem
조사대원님, 왕좌실로 가는 길을 엔더 골렘이 막고 있어요. 공허의 돌로: Surveyor, an ender golem is blocking the way to the throne room. A giant made of void stone. But it's strange. What the golem guards isn't the door… it's the eighth throne. So no one can sit on it. We have to bring the golem down to reach the altar.
Defeat the ender golem in the ruined citadel.
골렘이 무너진 자리에 회색 천 조각이 걸려 있었어요. 망토 자락이요. 천: Where the golem fell, a scrap of grey cloth was caught. The hem of a cloak. A thousand years, and it hasn't frayed. …Someone came all the way here and tried to sit on the eighth throne.
빈 왕좌의 문지기 — 엔더 가디언: Gatekeeper of the Empty Throne — The Ender Guardian
빈 왕좌를 지키는 엔더 가디언을 기억의 문 너머에서 쓰러뜨리게. 회색 천: Bring down the Ender Guardian that watches the empty throne beyond the Memory Gate. A scrap of grey cloth? …An old story. Hurry.
Open the Memory Gate and defeat the Ender Guardian.
가디언이 무너지며 여덟 번째 왕좌를 가리켰다. 그 자리에 앉은 사람은 없: As the Guardian crumbled, it pointed to the eighth throne. No one had sat there. For a thousand years.
The grey cloak… the Elder avoided the question.
여덟 개의 왕좌. 하나는 지워졌다.\n지운 것은 우리 일곱이다. 그 죄도:
Eight thrones. One was erased.
It was we seven who erased it. I will bear that sin as well.
마지막 봉인일세. 서리의 왕이 잠든 얼어붙은 감옥. 드라우그들이 지키고: The last seal. The frozen prison where the King of Frost sleeps. Draugr guard it. Elite draugr carry shields, so go for their backs. …Once this is done, that's all. Just this.
얼어붙은 감옥을 찾아가고, 드라우그 8명과 정예 드라우그 2명을 물리치게: Find the frosted prison and defeat 8 draugr and 2 elite draugr.
도착했군. 이제 마지막이네. (장로의 장갑에서 연기가 피어오른다.): You've arrived. This is the last one. (Smoke rises from the Elder's glove.)
서리의 왕이 잠든 감옥: The prison where the King of Frost sleeps
봉인의 문 — 왕의 근위대: The Sealed Door — The King's Guard
조사대원님, 감옥 안쪽에 왕의 근위대가 있어요. 왕관을 쓴 드라우그와 거: Surveyor, the king's guard is deep inside the prison. A crowned draugr and a huge aptrgangr. …And there's something I have to say. The Harbinger's prophecy, the scrap of grey cloth, the Elder's glove. The 'glove' my mother wrote on her last page. I'm done pretending not to know. Defeat the crowned draugr and the aptrgangr in the frosted prison.
근위대가 쓰러졌어요. 왕의 묘비가 갈라지고 있어요. …장로님이 감옥 입구: The guard has fallen. The king's tomb is cracking. …The Elder is at the prison entrance. He won't come in. Smoke keeps rising from his glove.

\"회색 망토의 학자여… 약속을 지켜라. 끝나지 않는 삶을.\" 말레딕투: "Scholar in the grey cloak… keep your promise. A life without end." With those words Maledictus shattered. At the prison entrance, a gloved hand gripped the doorframe.
제 4 장 · 서리의 왕: Chapter Four · The King of Frost
끝나지 않는 삶을 약속받은 왕: A king who was promised a life without end

Scholar in the grey cloak… keep your promise.
A life without end. A life like yours.
말레딕투스의 마지막 말, 들으셨어요? 회색 망토의 학자. 회색 금화. 항: Did you hear Maledictus's last words? The scholar in the grey cloak. The grey coins. The scholar who sold the route. The gloved hand. My mother's journal. It all… points to one man. Go to the Elder. Right now. I'm coming with you.
(장로가 천천히 장갑을 벗는다. 손등에 불꽃 모양의 낙인이 타오른다.): (The Elder slowly pulls off his glove. A flame-shaped brand burns on the back of his hand.) "Six Eyes are enough. I've waited a thousand years. …Your Corps proved useful." The Elder seized the six Eyes and vanished into the flames.

수도회 장로 에르윈: 마지막으로 제안하지. 불씨를 내게 넘기게. 그러면: Elder Erwin of the Order: One last offer. Hand your embers over to me. Then I'll spare the Corps.

…수도회 기록고의 등불이 꺼졌어요. 어머니의 등불이요. 장로님이… 에르윈: …The lantern in the Order's archive has gone out. My mother's lantern. When the Elder… when Erwin vanished, he took the fire with him. I'm fine. Really. Just — sit here with me a little while.

탐험대장 로란: 4장에서 봉인을 풀었다. 그게 놈의 계획이었다 해도, 너: Captain Roran: In chapter 4 you broke the seals. Even if that was his plan, the road you walked was no lie.

불을 지키고, 봉인을 지키고, 그리고…: Guard the flame, guard the seals, and…

기억의 조각 셋이다. 손에 쥐면 누군가 우는 소리가 들린다. 기록관이…: Three memory shards. Hold them and you hear someone weeping. The archivist… isn't here right now. Where did Isabel go?

(오스카가 조각을 맞춘다.) 에르윈은 여덟째 왕의 제자였다네. 스승이 봉: (Oscar fits the shards together.) Erwin was the eighth king's apprentice. 스승님, 기다리십시오.\n흩어진 불을 모두 모아, 반드시 이름을 돌려드리:
Master, wait for me.

종장 연대기의 마지막 장 (4/8): Finale: The Last Page of the Chronicle (4/8)
에르윈이 이사벨을 데려갔다. 지워진 이름을 연대기에 다시 쓰게 하려는 거: Erwin took Isabel. He wants her to write the erased name back into the Chronicle. What he failed to make Elena do, he'll make her daughter do. We go to the Burning Arena. The barrier before the throne is the First Flame. Only the ice crystal can put it out. The crystal you won from the Frostmaw in chapter 2.
Find the Burning Arena, go in, and hand the ice crystal to Captain Roran.
결정이 녹으며 불길이 가라앉았다. 왕좌 앞에 이사벨이 묶여 있다. 펜을: The crystal melted and the flames died down. Isabel is bound before the throne. She never opened the hand gripping her pen. And before her… Erwin thrust his hand into the First Flame. From the flame rises an armored knight. The knight from the dream.
종장 연대기의 마지막 장 (5/8): Finale: The Last Page of the Chronicle (5/8)
이그니스다. 불꽃 기사단장 아르덴. 천 년 전 일곱 왕의 불을 지키던 기: Ignis. Arden, Grand Master of the Flame Knights. The knight who guarded the seven kings' fire a thousand years ago. Now he's bound by Erwin's flame. He splits the earth with his flaming sword, blocks with his shield, and at the end wreathes himself in blue hellfire. The whole expedition goes. Open the Memory Gate. When he falls, give him an ember.
Open the Memory Gate and defeat Ignis.
쓰러진 기사의 눈에서 불이 꺼지고, 사람의 눈빛이 돌아왔다. \"이번에는: The fire went out of the fallen knight's eyes, and a human gaze returned. "This time, you guard it." As the flame died, an old man in a grey cloak fell to his knees. Clutching a thousand years of ash. Now you must decide.
불꽃 기사단장 아르덴: Arden, Grand Master of the Flame Knights
You've come again, you who hold the embers.
…This time, you guard it.
Forgive Erwin. Leave his name in the Chronicle.
Erase Erwin's name. Like the names he erased.
종장 연대기의 마지막 장 (6/8): Finale: The Last Page of the Chronicle (6/8)
…Thank you for saving me. Erwin kept trying to put the pen in my hand to the very end. But it's strange. I wasn't afraid. My mother read to the end, so I decided I'd refuse to write, to the end. And I found this inside Erwin's cloak. The original of my mother's oath. It has the third line Erwin erased.
Read the third line with Archivist Isabel.
\"불을 지키고, 봉인을 지킨다. 그리고 때가 되면 놓아준다.\" …놓아: "Guard the flame, guard the seals. And when the time comes, let go." …Let go. That's the line Erwin hated. Because he couldn't let go of his master. But there was one more line inside the cloak. 'The eighth king's fire became a storm, and sleeps in a temple above the sea.' …I'll think about that later.
Archivist Isabel: One, guard the flame.
Archivist Isabel: Two, guard the seals.
Archivist Isabel: Three… when the time comes, let go.
종장 연대기의 마지막 장 (7/8): Finale: The Last Page of the Chronicle (7/8)
The storm has passed. At that pier where you first came ashore. Everyone's out there. Greet them one by one. That's what an expedition is.
Greet Oscar the fisher and Captain Roran.
(부두에 노을이 진다. 오스카의 그물, 로란의 지도, 이사벨의 펜.) 다: (The sun sets over the pier. Oscar's net, Roran's map, Isabel's pen.) Everyone called your name. Remembering each other's names is what sea folk do.
Oscar the Fisher: The net is heavy. The sea has turned honest.
Oscar the Fisher: Elric must be laughing somewhere too.
Captain Roran: You're here. The storm's over.
Captain Roran: The Corps is an expedition now. I'll call on you for the next one too.
Captain Roran: …We left no one behind. Thank you.
종장 연대기의 마지막 장 (8/8): Finale: The Last Page of the Chronicle (8/8)
모두 끝났어요. 이제 연대기의 마지막 장을 함께 써요. 어머니가 끝까지: It's all over. Now let's write the last page of the Chronicle together. The Chronicle my mother read to the end — I'll write it to the end.
Write the last page with Archivist Isabel.
\"불을 지키고, 봉인을 지키고, 그리고 놓아주었다.\" …마지막 장이에: "Guarded the flame, guarded the seals, and let go." …That's the last page. I wrote it in the name of every single surveyor. Yours too. The First Flame will blaze up in his form again every week. Putting that fire to rest is your job now.
폭풍이 그친 부두에서: At the pier where the storm ended
숨은 이야기 · 거울 속의 연대기 (0/2): Hidden Story · The Chronicle in the Mirror (0/2)
조사대원님, 견습 기록관 미아가 할 말이 있대요. 그날 불 속에서 구해: Surveyor, Mia the apprentice archivist has something to tell you. The girl you saved from the fire that day. When she heard you saw the Council of the Eight Kings in the Abyss, something came back to her.
견습 기록관 미아의 이야기를 들으세요. (기록관 이사벨에게): Hear out Mia the apprentice archivist. (Speak to Isabel the archivist.)
미아가 그날 밤 연기 속에서 봤대요. 타지 않은 페이지 몇 장에 보랏빛: Mia saw something in the smoke that night. Some of the unburnt pages had corrections in violet ink. Someone rewrote the Chronicle. …The shelves burned, but Mia's memory survived instead.
Mia the Apprentice Archivist: In the fire that day… I saw pages that had fallen on the floor.
견습 기록관 미아: 글자 위에 보랏빛 잉크로 덧쓴 자국이 있었어요. 거울: Mia the Apprentice Archivist: Someone had written over the letters in violet ink. The writing was reversed, like a reflection in a mirror.
Mia the Apprentice Archivist: I was too scared to say anything. I'm sorry.
숨은 이야기 · 거울 속의 연대기 (단서): Hidden Story · The Chronicle in the Mirror (Clue)

I remember the face of everyone who comes every day. You came today too.
Good things await once your stamps pile up. Collect them at your own pace.
어서 오세요! 식당 주인 로렌초예요. 오늘의 요리, 벨리시모!: Welcome! I'm Lorenzo, the restaurant owner. Today's dish — bellissimo!
요리는 사랑이에요! 그리고 버터. 사랑과 버터!: Cooking is love! And butter. Love and butter!
재료를 가져오시면 제가 비싸게 사 드려요. 좋은 재료는 좋은 요리가 되니: Bring me ingredients and I'll pay well for them. Good ingredients make good dishes!
마르타 씨네 빵은 최고예요. 제 수프랑 먹으면… 아, 천국!: Martha's bread is the best. Eat it with my soup and… ah, heaven!
My dream is to feed everyone in Vestalia my cooking someday.
원정대에도 도시락을 싸 드리고 싶어요. 배고픈 영웅은 슬프잖아요!: I'd love to pack lunches for the expedition too. A hungry hero is a sad thing!
베스탈리아 은행 그레고리입니다. 무엇을 도와드릴까요?: Gregory of the Bank of Vestalia. How may I help you?
Deposits are safe. Even if you fall, the bank's money doesn't disappear.
Money in your wallet is exposed to danger. I recommend depositing large sums.
Numbers are honest. That's what I like about them.
The Bank of Vestalia was the first building raised after the storm.
To make people trust each other, we first had to make them trust money.
직업 안내인 알버트예요. 어떤 길을 걸을지 정하셨나요?: I'm Albert, the job guide. Have you decided which path to walk?
Every job comes with buffs and debuffs. No path has only upsides.
검사는 검에, 궁수는 활에 강해요. 무기 설명에 분류가 적혀 있으니 확인: Swordsmen are strong with swords, archers with bows. The weapon descriptions list each weapon's class, so check them.
Life jobs matter too. An expedition doesn't run on swords alone.
You have to finish the prerequisite quest before you can choose that job.
이미 직업이 있으면 다른 직업의 선행 퀘스트는 할 수 없어요. 한 길에: If you already have a job, you can't do another job's prerequisite quests. Focus on one path.
If you want to change, come back. There's a price, though.
I'm Haru, the town clerk. I'll stamp your attendance for today.
Records are kept without omission. That is a clerk's job.
Ellie runs the attendance shop. Spend your stamps there.
Vestalia's population is growing. So is the paperwork.
The town hall holds the name of every settler since the storm.
단 한 사람, 수도회 장로의 이주 기록만 없습니다. 처음부터 여기 계셨다: There's only one person with no settlement record: the Elder of the Order. They say he was here from the beginning.
The grey-coin bounty was also posted fifteen years ago, in the spring.
That spring, I was also the one who took the missing-person report for Archivist Elena.
The one who took the report away was… the Elder.
시청 기록에 이상한 항목이 하나 있습니다. '폭풍의 여제께 바치는 세금,: There's one strange entry in the town hall records. 'Tax owed to the Empress of Storms: unpaid.' Dated a thousand years ago.
숲속 저택 주변의 안개 민원이 들어온 적이 있습니다. 담당자는 '거울이: We once received a complaint about the mist around the woodland mansion. The official wrote 'the mirrors don't reflect people' and dropped the investigation.
행운 상인 럭키라구! 오늘은 뭐가 나올까~?: Lucky the luck merchant, that's me! What'll come out today~?
전설은 기다리는 자에게 온다지! 아마도!: They say legends come to those who wait! Probably!
YAMATO? 그거 본 사람은 손에 꼽는다구. 근데 너라면 혹시?: YAMATO? You can count the people who've seen one on one hand. But maybe you?
꽝도 분해하면 조각이 된다구. 버릴 건 하나도 없지!: Even a dud becomes shards if you dismantle it. Nothing goes to waste!
있잖아, 진짜 행운은 뽑기에만 있는 게 아니라구. 폭풍 치는 날 하늘에서: You know, real luck isn't only in the gacha. Like paper falling from the sky on a stormy day? Never mind~
보랏빛 잉크로 쓴 복권은 절대 사지 마! 당첨 번호가 거울처럼 뒤집혀 있: Never buy a lottery ticket written in violet ink! The winning numbers are reversed like a mirror!
Hors, adjutant of the Flame Knights' second company.
단장 아르덴이 남긴 \"내가 돌아올 때까지 문을 지켜라\"는 말을: The words left by Grand Master Arden — "Guard the door until I return" —
천 년 동안 지켰다. 갑옷이 녹슬고 이름을 잊어도,: he kept for a thousand years. Though his armor rusted and he forgot his name,
he never once left the door.
A giant raised by the children of the northern frost kingdom.
왕국이 저주로 얼어붙던 날, 아이들이 마지막으로 맡긴: On the day the kingdom froze under the curse, it fell asleep cradling
the ice crystal the children entrusted to it last.
That crystal holds a cold that can put fire to sleep.
The stonemason who carved the seven seals into stone.
Just as he went to carve the eighth seat, his master's hand stopped him.
On the mountaintop, he still asks why that space was left blank.
보아라, 남쪽 하늘의 태양을!: Behold the sun in the southern sky!
High priest of the southern tribe.
어느 밤 하늘에 두 번째 태양이 떠오른 뒤로,: Ever since a second sun rose in the night sky one evening,
he worshipped its light as a god and slowly burned away.
A pirate who sailed the fastest ship on the seven seas.
회색 망토의 학자가 판 항로를 따라 눈을 훔치러 갔고,: She followed a route sold by the scholar in the grey cloak to steal an Eye,
and on the way back she froze along with the sea.
She still calls out her sailors' names.
A giant hammered together by piglin smiths with soul fire stolen from the Burning Arena.
Its masters all burned to death in that fire, and it never heard the order to stop.
왕을 기다리는 짐승: The Beast That Awaits Its King
A loyal beast kept by the last pharaoh of the desert dynasty.
봉인을 만든 일곱 중 하나였던 주인을 기다리며,: Waiting for its master, one of the seven who made the seals,
it raises its head only to one who bears the necklace.
It is an apprentice who opens the last gate.
A machine the illagers built "to see the end of the world in advance."
After it delivered its final prophecy, its makers hid it away.
예언의 마지막 줄: \"마지막 문을 여는 것은 견습이다.\": The last line of the prophecy: "It is an apprentice who opens the last gate."
The guardian of the abyss that the deeplings of the sunken city served for a thousand years.
Since the day its Eye was stolen, it has been unable to close its eyes.
여덟 개의 왕좌 중 빈 자리를 지키라는 명령을 받았지만,: It was ordered to guard the empty seat among the eight thrones,
but it does not know whose seat that was.
약속을 기다리는 왕: The King Who Awaits a Promise
회색 망토의 학자가 약속한 \"끝나지 않는 삶\"을 대가로 봉인을 내주었: He gave up his seal in exchange for the "life without end" promised by the scholar in the grey cloak,
and his kingdom froze under a curse.
He still waits for the one who will keep that promise.
Arden, Grand Master of the Flame Knights.
He swallowed the First Flame himself and bound the seven seals into one.
Burning for a thousand years, in his dreams he always awaited the next apprentice.
The Empress of Storms, who was entrusted with the eighth seal.
The other seven erased her name from the Chronicle.
Only those who meet her can learn why.
Belloc the Illusioner, who rewrote the Order's Chronicle.
장로 에르윈의 부탁으로 진실을 거울 뒤에 감추고: At Elder Erwin's request he hid the truth behind the mirror
and took one gold coin for every false page.
The true last page of the Chronicle is still inside his mirror.
녹슨 문 앞에 보이지 않는 벽이 있다. 수도회의 기록관이 먼저 할 이야기: An invisible wall stands before the rusted door. The Order's archivist said there's something she needs to tell you first.
A blizzard blocks the way. You don't yet know what the giant holds.
태양 가면의 부족이 이방인을 들이지 않는다. 탐험대장의 소개장이 필요하다: The tribe of the sun mask won't let strangers in. You need a letter of introduction from the expedition captain.
The mountaintop wind pushes you back. It's not yet time to climb.
The ghost ship on the ice withdraws into the mist. You don't yet know the captain's name.
The maze beneath the water is closed.
The forge's fire is out. The seals must be taken in order.
The void altar does not answer. The seals must be taken in order.
The machine's heart is asleep. The seals must be taken in order.
The abyssal altar is cold. The seals must be taken in order.
The sealed door won't budge. The seals must be taken in order.
The cursed tombstone is silent. The seals must be taken in order.
The altar of fire pushes you away. You must break the seven seals first.
The storm does not recognize you. You must find the erased name first.
The mansion is wrapped in violet mist. The mirrors don't reflect your face. You must find the Chronicle's blank page first.
결계: flag 표식이 없는 사람은 bosses 의 보스에게 다가가거나: Seal: anyone without the flag cannot approach the bosses listed in bosses or use the blocks (boss summons) listed in blocks.
잘하셨어요! 이제 베스탈리아 사람이에요. 은행도, 상점도, 땅도 여러분: Well done! You're one of Vestalia's people now. The bank, the shops, the land are all yours. Funny thing, though. Every Corps ship meets a storm on the way in. And not one comes in with a torn sail. The sailors say the storm circles the ship once and just leaves. As if it were having a look. Oh, and the Order was looking for the new surveyors.
네가 이번 배의 조사대원이냐. 탐험대장 로란이다. …지팡이? 스무 해 묵: So you're off this ship. Captain Roran. …The cane? A twenty-year-old leg. Never mind it. The Corps doesn't run on swords alone: a smith forges, a cook boils the soup, a fisher reads the sea. Go see Albert the job guide and choose your road.
좋다. 네 몫을 하는 놈이 조사대에 남는다. 나는 이제 먼 길은 못 간다: Good. Those who pull their weight stay. I can't travel far any more. My work is making sure you eat and have a place to come back to. The Elder is waiting for the new faces.
어서 오게. 잿불 수도회 장로 에르윈일세. (장갑을 낀 손으로 악수를 청: Welcome. I am Erwin, Elder of the Ember Order. (He offers a gloved hand.) Before the oath there is something to learn: what we guard, and why we fight only inside a Memory Gate. I have opened a practice gate in the yard. Hear me out, then look at it yourself.
Listen to Elder Erwin's lesson, then examine the practice Memory Gate beside you.
You saw it. The scarecrow inside is not real. It is the scarecrow the Flame remembers. Guardians are put to rest the same way, only inside a gate. Break the body outside and the seal bursts. …One day you will see a sea that paid that price. Now, the oath.
수도회 일을 하려면 견습 서약을 해야 하네. 기록관 이사벨에게서 서약서를: To work for the Order you must take the apprentice's oath. Fetch the oath scroll from Isabel the archivist. She was born and raised in the archive; I taught her letters myself. Then recite it before me: "Guard the fire, guard the seals."
\"불을 지키고, 봉인을 지킨다.\" …좋네. 이 불씨를 받게. 자네 이: "Guard the fire, guard the seals." …Good. Take this ember. It will hold on to your name once. Stop by the kitchen before the soup goes cold. Not for me, I can't take hot food. Lie down early tonight. Sleep runs deep the first day you hold an ember.
조사대원님, 봐 주실 게 있어요. 수도회의 「잿빛 연대기」예요. 천 년: Surveyor, there's something I'd like you to look at. This is the Order's Ashen Chronicle, the story of how seven kings divided the world's fire a thousand years ago. Pages are missing here and there. People say they fell out with age… please look for yourself. And the mural on the archive wall, too. The 'price' the Elder spoke of is painted there.
In the archive, examine the cut pages of the Chronicle and the mural.
칼자국이죠? 누가 잘라 낸 거예요. 열다섯 해 전, 기록관이던 어머니 엘: Knife marks, aren't they? Someone cut them out. Fifteen years ago my mother Elena, the archivist then, went looking for these pages and never came back. Her last note is one line: 'The first page, beside the broken gate.' …I have never been outside the archive. Will you come with me?
'무너진 문'은 무너진 지옥문이에요. 들판 여기저기 서 있는, 금 박힌: The 'broken gate' is a ruined hellgate, the black stone frames studded with gold that stand in the fields. Your compass will point the way. I'm coming too. …Captain Roran tied my bootlaces. He checked them three times.
무너진 지옥문을 찾아가, 이사벨과 함께 문에 남은 것을 살펴보세요. (조: Find a ruined hellgate and examine what is left on it together with Isabel. (The survey compass points the way.)
"Seven caged the fire, and the fire caged one." It's the first page. An ink dot in the corner… the same as in the book at the archive. It was the mark Mother left wherever she found something. She stood here. Right here.
첫 장 뒷면에 어머니 글씨가 있었어요. '오래된 길의 폐허, 항아리에 표: There was Mother's writing on the back of the page: 'Ruins on the old road, a mark on a pot.' Trail ruins. If you brush the dirt away you find pottery sherds. I've only read about brushing. Please find me one sherd.
이사벨과 함께 흔적 유적의 항아리를 살펴보고, 붓으로 도기 조각을 파내: Brush a pottery sherd out of the trail ruins and bring it back. (A brush is made of a feather, copper and a stick.)
이 조각이에요. 잉크 점 옆에 날짜가 있어요. 열다섯 해 전 봄. 그리고: This is the one. A date beside the ink dot: spring, fifteen years ago. And a name, 'Dowin, miner'. …But wasn't that ruin strange? The village's name isn't anywhere in the Chronicle. Just like the village on the mural.
광부 도윈? 그 이름은 안다. 술집 외상 장부에 아직 이름이 있지. 열다: Dowin the miner? I know that name. It's still on the tavern's tab. He went into the old mine fifteen years ago and never came out. Where those tunnels lead… I don't know. But miners carve words into the timbers. Go and read them. There are spiders down there. Bring plenty of light.
Find the abandoned mine and examine the words carved into the timber.
'엘레나 씨는 사막으로. 나는 여기 남는다.' …도윈은 길잡이였군. 엘레: 'I sent Elena on to the desert. I stay here.' …So Dowin was the guide. He sent her ahead and stayed behind alone. A guide isn't the one who goes first. He's the one who stays last. (Roran shifts his grip on the cane.) Have the archivist write that name down.
도윈 씨 이름을 연대기에 적었어요. 적고 나니까… 배가 고파요. 이상하죠: I wrote Dowin's name into the Chronicle. And then… I got hungry. Strange. In the archive it was always cold bread, but after walking outside I want something warm. Grilled fish and bread will do. Eat with me.
구운 대구 2개와 빵 2개를 가져오세요. (식당이나 낚시·요리로 구할 수: Bring 2 cooked cod and 2 bread. (From the restaurant, or by fishing and cooking.)
(이사벨이 생선 가시를 하나하나 세며 먹는다.) 맛있어요. 장로님은 같이: (Isabel counts the bones as she eats.) It's good. The Elder never eats with us. He says he can't take hot food. It's been that way since I was little. …Mother liked fish. That isn't written in the Chronicle. That's something I know.
기록관이 다음은 사막이라더군. 이번엔 너 혼자 간다. 그럼 너부터 굴려야: The archivist says the desert is next. You go alone this time. Then I'd better drill you first. Before that, go out into the fields at night and watch one of the withered to the end. Look before you cut. The ones who know what they're cutting last longer. The desert? Never been. I only know the southern woods, the snowfields and the sun lands. Saying 'I don't know' when you don't is a captain's job.
Watch a withered one in the fields at night, then put the 3 that follow you to rest.
봤나. 놈들은 산 사람을 따라온다. 불 켜진 창 앞에 서서 입을 달싹인다: You saw it. They follow the living. They stand before a lit window and their mouths move. The Elder says it's because they want their names called. I don't know. I only know people who know. …Count heads twice. Once going out, once coming back. That much I do know.
도윈 씨가 어머니를 사막으로 보냈어요. 사막 피라미드 아래에 둘째 장이: Dowin sent Mother to the desert. The second page should be under a desert pyramid. The books say the floor pattern hides a trap. I want to come, but… this time I'll stay in the archive. I'm copying the first page and Dowin's words into the Chronicle, and I can't leave my desk until the ink dries. I packed two water flasks instead. Take both. One is for the way back.
사막 피라미드를 찾아 아래 방에 남은 흔적을 살펴보고, 그늘에서 숨을 돌: Find a desert pyramid, examine the traces left in the chamber below, and catch your breath in the shade.
\"사막의 왕은 모래 속의 눈을 받았고, 서리의 왕은 얼음 속의 눈을 받: "The king of the desert took the eye in the sand, the king of frost the eye in the ice." The second page. But the chest was already open? If they counted it and didn't take it… they are telling someone 'there is a page here.' Someone besides us is following Mother's marks. And not long ago. (Isabel takes back one empty flask and one half full.) …The note. Did you see the back as well? I thought I had crossed it out. Please pretend you didn't.
Crossbow bolts and heavy boots. The Ashen Band. In town they just call them pillagers. Their watchtowers overlook every village. Why would they count scraps of paper? Because someone pays. Hit a tower and see what they were paid.
At a pillager outpost defeat 6 pillagers and examine the tower's banner.
회색 금화라. 처음 보는 돈이다. 그리고 그 노래… 도적이 부를 노래가: Grey coins. Money I've never seen. And that song… not a song bandits sing. Show the coin at the town hall, they have a nose for money. Take the song to the archivist. I don't understand either.
정리하겠습니다. 첫째, 이 금화는 기록에 없습니다. 둘째, 같은 현상금이: Let me sum up. One, this coin is in no record. Two, the same bounty was posted twice, in two different hands. Three, the front and the back were struck from different dies. There may be more than one person paying. Ledgers cannot lie.
어머니의 동행이 한 명 더 있었어요. 지도 제작자 펠릭스. 첫 장 여백에: Mother had one more companion: Felix the mapmaker. In the margin of the first page it says 'Felix left at the infirmary in the snow.' The cellar under an igloo. Left there… so he was ill. They say someone is locked in down there. The medicine should still be in the infirmary. The gold we have to bring ourselves: one golden apple. Gold is the metal that doesn't forget a name.
이글루를 찾아 치료소의 기록을 살펴보고, 황금 사과 1개로 지하실에 갇힌: Find an igloo, examine the infirmary's records, and bring back the one locked in its cellar with 1 golden apple.
펠릭스 씨였어요. 열다섯 해 동안 지하실에서… 다행이에요. 정말 다행이에: It was Felix. Fifteen years in that cellar… thank goodness. Truly. But the signature in the record, the drawing of a hand. A gloved hand, you say? …All the old physicians must have signed that way. They must have.
고기를 못 먹는 사람: The Man Who Can't Eat Meat
Felix can't eat anything. The smell of meat alone turns him white. He won't say why. …I think he's wondering what he ate for fifteen years. Please bring something warm with no meat in it. Beetroot soup and baked potatoes.
Bring 1 beetroot soup and 3 baked potatoes.
(펠릭스가 수프를 오래 들여다보다가 한 숟갈 뜬다.) 드셨어요. 한 그릇: (Felix stares into the soup for a long time, then takes a spoonful.) He ate. The whole bowl. Then he asked for paper. He wants to draw a map. He says the hand remembers the road it walked, even when the head forgets.
펠릭스 씨가 지도를 그리다 멈췄어요. 늪까지는 그렸는데 그다음이 조각조각: Felix stopped drawing. He got as far as the swamp and after that it's all in pieces. He needs more paper and ink. And… please stay with him. His hands shake each time a memory comes back.
종이 6장과 먹물 주머니 2개를 가져와, 펠릭스가 지도를 잇는 것을 지켜: Bring 6 paper and 2 ink sacs, and watch Felix piece the map together.
늪의 마녀예요. 어머니가 거기서 '보이지 않는 잉크'를 구했대요. 일지: The swamp witch. Mother got 'invisible ink' from her. Now I know why some journal pages are blank. And Felix remembered one more thing. There were four of them. Mother, Dowin, Felix… he can't recall the fourth one's face.
늪지대 오두막의 마녀가 보이지 않는 잉크를 만들어요. 발광 먹물 주머니가: The witch of the swamp hut makes invisible ink. She takes glow ink sacs as payment. Only… she doesn't tell customers from thieves very well. I leave how you get it to you. But do examine the ink jar. I'll stay behind again. Felix keeps waking in the night, and when he wakes he doesn't know where he is for a long while. There should be at least one face he knows beside him.
늪지대 오두막을 찾아 잉크 단지와 창턱을 살펴보고, 발광 먹물 주머니 3: Find a swamp hut, examine the ink jar and the windowsill, and bring 3 glow ink sacs.
'블레이즈 불빛 아래에서만 드러난다.' 어머니는 일지를 일부러 그렇게 썼: 'Shows only under blaze light.' Mother wrote her journal that way on purpose, so no one could read it in secret. But what is the purple ink at the bottom of the jar? 'Belongs to the people in the mirror'… there are no such people in the Chronicle. …On the windowsill? Two marks. (Isabel says nothing for a long time, then stands with her back against the doorpost.) I grew more than two finger joints. Much more. Would you draw it again? In Mother's place.
봉화의 불빛이라. 블레이즈 막대가 필요하겠군. 지옥에 있네. 가라앉은 왕: Beacon light. You'll need blaze rods, then. They are in Hell: the sunken kingdom of Caldera, the place people call Hell. Roran told you to dress for snow? Ha, he has never been. It is hot. Very. It is your first crossing, so I will go with you. Open the gate, step through, and look at the sky.
지옥문을 열고 지옥에 들어가 하늘을 살펴보고, 블레이즈 막대 3개를 가져: Open a hellgate, enter Hell and examine its sky, then bring 3 blaze rods.
(장로는 돌아오는 내내 말이 없었다.) …막대는 이사벨에게 주게. 기록고: (The Elder said nothing all the way back.) …Give the rods to Isabel. The lamp in the archive was the one Elena kept lit. I need to rest. Whenever I see that sky I… no, I am startled like a man seeing it for the first time.
막대와 잉크가 다 모였어요. 기록고 맨 안쪽에 어머니의 방이 있어요. 어: We have the rods and the ink. Mother's room is at the very back of the archive. I haven't gone in once since she vanished. The lamp is still dark. …Will you come with me? I can't make myself take the doorknob alone.
Light her mother's lamp together with Isabel the archivist.
'아무도 돌아오지 못하는 세 끝.' 불타는 요새, 소리가 사라지는 도시,: 'Three ends from which no one returns.' The burning fortress, the city where sound dies, the end of the void. She hid them where whoever hunts the pages couldn't follow. Mother walked all three. So will I. I'm done with only reading.
첫째 끝은 지옥의 요새예요. 펠릭스 씨가 길을 안대요. 일지에는 이렇게: The first end is the fortress in Hell. Felix knows the way. The journal says: 'The fortress is not a castle but a dike. Read the three order slabs and you will know what the Black Star is.' I can't go this time, the Elder forbade it. Tell me everything you read.
Find a hell fortress and examine the three order slabs.
돌격하라, 버텨라, 백성부터 빼라. 세 대장이 서로 다른 명령을 내렸군요: Charge, hold, get the people out first. Three captains gave three different orders. Hargen, Isolde, Merwin. Their names aren't in the Chronicle. It says the Flame Knights had four captains, but the names are scorched away. …Four. Who was the fourth?
큰일이다. 펠릭스가 요새에서 검은 해골에게 베여 돌아왔다. 상처가 검게: Trouble. Felix came back from the fortress cut by a black skeleton. The wound is withering black. No ordinary poison. Poison I'd know. The ones who knew this sickness must have left something in the fortress barracks, since they're the ones who caught it. Read the barracks wall and brew an antidote. Fast.
요새의 병영 낙서를 살펴보고, 위더 스켈레톤 5마리를 물리치고, 펠릭스에: Examine the barracks scrawl in the fortress, defeat 5 wither skeletons, and bring 1 antidote for Felix. (Brewed from a glass bottle, charcoal, sweet berries and a brown mushroom.)
(펠릭스가 해독제를 넘기자 상처의 검은 빛이 걷힌다.) 살았군. 숯이 재: (As Felix swallows the antidote the black fades from the wound.) He'll live. So the charcoal draws out the ash. The ash of a burnt name. …Then those black skeletons were people. Knights who never left their posts. I know men like that.
지키려던 사람들 위에서: Standing on Those They Meant to Save
어머니 일지에 요새에서 베낀 글이 있어요. 「세 머리의 서약」이래요. ': Mother copied something in the fortress into her journal. The Oath of Three Heads. 'When the wall is breached, set the three captains' heads upon soul sand.' The three captains become one sentinel of their own will. Soul sand is… the ash of Caldera's people whose names the fire ate. The sentinel rises on top of the people it was meant to protect. Mother hid the page 'beside the Black Star's heart'. It can only be taken by waking it. And the journal has one more line: 'Waking them is the only way to free them.'
Bring 3 wither skeleton skulls and 4 soul sand.
세 머리… 하르겐, 이졸데, 메르윈. 천 년 동안 초소를 돌던 기사들이: Three heads… Hargen, Isolde, Merwin. The knights who walked their posts for a thousand years were carrying their captains' heads between them. Let's open a Memory Gate. It isn't bound to a seal, but the Black Star erases the name of everything it touches. We can't wake it near the town.
The Black Star. The mural says 'when the Black Star rises the fire goes out.' Not only the fire. To it, everything alive looks like fire. It can't tell friend from foe. The three heads move apart because the three captains are still arguing. Knock the skulls back. Keep moving. Beyond the Memory Gate only you and your party fight.
Open the Memory Gate and put the Black Star (the Wither) to rest.
별이 식으며 그을린 종이 한 장이 떨어졌다. 엘레나의 페이지다. 그리고: As the star cooled a scorched page fell. Elena's page. And one star left behind. They say it's three names set hard. Take it to the archivist. It isn't over until she writes them.
지옥의 별을 보여 주세요. …따뜻해요. 문 안에서 잠든 존재는 불꽃에서: Show me the star. …It's warm. What falls asleep inside a gate is let go by the Flame. With nothing holding it, the world slowly begins to forget its name. So I write it. The fire can't eat a written name. Stay and watch.
Watch Isabel the archivist write down the three captains' names.
적었어요. 하르겐, 이졸데, 메르윈. 그리고 빈 줄 하나. 넷째 대장의: It's done. Hargen, Isolde, Merwin. And one empty line. The fourth captain's place. …Sleep well tonight. You found three names today. My mother used to say a name once written finds its own place overnight.
조사대원님! 다들 축하한다고 난리예요. 그, 그거 잡으셨다면서요. 그…: Surveyor! Everyone's celebrating. You beat that, that thing… what was it called? I knew yesterday. The black… black what? Strange. Anyway! The restaurant owner is treating everyone. And listen about the eastern fields. The patrols saw something odd.
Hear the town's news from Morris the guide.
웃고 넘길 일이죠? 저만 그런 게 아니더라고요. 식당에서도 다들 '그 검: Something to laugh off, right? It isn't just me. At the restaurant they all just say 'that black thing'. Only the archivist says it clearly. …Oh, the fields. The Ashen Band is gathering. More than a few.
The Ashen Band is coming. This one is mine. Bad leg or not, I can command. Bram the smith picked up his hammer. Go with him and break their vanguard in the eastern fields. Don't ring the town bell. They come to the sound. The archivist knows why.
Together with Bram, defeat 1 ravager and 4 vindicators.
Head count. Two out, two back. Good. The one we caught said Captain Kas's men keep what they gather in catacombs underground. Nobody searches among the dead. And he said something odd: 'We didn't come to steal. We came to collect.'
The catacombs. Find out what they came to 'collect'. It's crawling with zombies. Hiding things among the withered is clever. Nobody wants to stay long.
땅 밑의 지하 묘지를 찾아 좀비를 8마리 물리치고, 관 위에 놓인 것을: Find the catacombs underground, defeat 8 zombies, and examine what lies on the coffin.
오늘 밤, 기록고라고? …지금 당장 돌아가라! 인원은 내가 센다, 뛰어!: Tonight, the archive? …Go back right now! I'll count heads, run!
조사대원님! 기록고가… 불이에요! 연기 때문에 앞이 안 보여요. 서가에는: Surveyor! The archive… it's on fire! I can't see through the smoke. Mother's records are still on the shelves… and there, Mia the apprentice has collapsed! We can't save both!
…불은 꺼졌어요. 무엇을 먼저 구했는지는 당신이 골랐어요. 둘 다 옳은: …The fire is out. You chose what to save first. Both were right. The names written in the burnt books… only I know them now. If I forget, they're gone. And Kas took the back pages of the journal.
다들 잿빛 무리가 불을 질렀다고 해요. 그런데 이상해요. 페이지를 가지러: Everyone says the Ashen Band set the fire. But it's strange. Why would people who came for the pages burn the place the pages are in? I'm an archivist. I write only what was seen. Look at where the fire began with me.
불탄 기록고에서 불이 시작된 자리와 바닥의 발자국, 그을린 벽을 살펴보세: In the burnt archive examine where the fire started, the footprints on the floor and the scorched wall.
지른 불이 아니었어요. 사고였어요. 그리고 카스는 달아나다 말고 돌아와서: It wasn't arson. It was an accident. And Kas stopped running, went back, and carried one of his men out, when we could have arrived any moment. …I'll write it. As it was seen. Whoever that record favours.
카스는 땅 밑의 언데드 요새로 들어갔다. 소환사답게 시든 것들 틈을 거처: Kas went into the undead fortress underground. Like a true evoker he lives among the withered. Open the way before the journal pages reach the grey cloak. Skeleton archers in every hall. If you see the grey cloak… don't chase. Not yet.
Find the undead fortress underground and defeat 8 skeletons.
회색 망토는 없었다. 맨 안쪽 방에 카스가 혼자 있다. 부하들은 다 내보: No grey cloak. Kas is alone in the innermost room. He sent his men away, the wounded first. …Not what a bandit chief does. In the open he pours out vexes. Let's pull him alone into a Memory Gate.
선장 카스. 기억의 문을 열어 놈만 끌어내라. 놈은 수호자가 아니다. 문: Captain Kas. Open the Memory Gate and pull only him in. He is no guardian. He won't turn to ash if he falls inside. He'll drop outside the gate still breathing. Watch the fangs rising from the floor. The totem he holds is a sliver of ember handed down for generations. He'll get up once.
Open the Memory Gate and defeat Captain Kas (the evoker).
놈의 짐이다. 일지 뒷장. 그리고 이건 지도다. 낡았다. 스무 해는 됐겠: His pack. The journal's back pages. And this is a map. Old. Twenty years at least. …Wait. This signature. Roran, Kael. My name. This is my expedition's map. (Roran is silent a long while.) …He's tied up. Decide with the archivist what to do with him. She's the one who was wronged.
받으러 온 사람: The One Who Came to Collect
카스와 이야기했어요. 묶인 채로도 깃발의 그 노래를 불렀어요. '우리에겐: I talked with Kas. Even tied up he sang that song from the banner. 'We had a king.' To him the Chronicle wasn't money. It was his people's family record. The fire… he said he was sorry. He made no excuses. Surveyor, I'm angry. But I don't know that he was wrong. Decide with me.
Decide together with Isabel the archivist what to do with Captain Kas.
정했어요. 어느 쪽이든 저는 그 사람의 이름을 적을 거예요. 카스. 잿빛: It's decided. Either way I'll write his name. Kas, captain of the Ashen Band. A man who tried to repay what was taken by taking. And a man who went back into the fire and carried his own out. I'll write both. That's what a record must do.
일지 뒷장이에요. '땅 밑 깊은 어둠, 소리가 사라지는 도시. 문 앞에: The journal's back page: 'Deep dark below, the city where sound dies. I buried the page before the door.' An ancient city. They say it was the city of Velas, the King of Silence. Why a whole city forbade sound, the Chronicle doesn't say in a single line. Go and read it there. Walk crouched. One sound and something wakes.
고대 도시를 찾아 침묵 법전과 주민 명부를 살펴보세요. (웅크리고 걸으세: Find an ancient city and examine the Code of Silence and the roll of residents. (Walk crouched.)
이름을 소리 내어 부르지 못하게 한 도시. 사람을 번호로 불렀고요. 불이: A city where no name could be spoken aloud. People were called by numbers. The king buried the names the fire ate, and sculk grew over them. It reacts to sound… because it is waiting for its name to be called. It wasn't frightening. It was sad.
어머니는 도시의 메아리 조각에 목소리를 남겼대요. '메아리는 들은 것을: Mother left her voice in the city's echo shards. 'An echo does not forget what it heard.' Please gather the shards. I want to… hear her voice. For fifteen years I've only read her handwriting.
(The shards knock together and give a faint voice.) …That's Mother. Lower than I thought. I remembered a higher voice. My memory was wrong. The shard is right.
큰일이다. 기록관이 없다. 인원을 두 번 셌다. 없다. 메아리 조각을 쥐: Trouble. The archivist is gone. I counted twice. Gone. She took the echo shards down into the ancient city alone, to hear more of her mother's voice. I can't take those stairs. This leg makes noise. You go. Crouch past the sensors and bring her back. Do not run.
(이사벨이 떨리는 손으로 메아리 조각을 쥐고 있다. 로란이 말없이 인원을: (Isabel grips the shards with shaking hands. Roran silently counts. Two.) …I'm sorry. From inside the door Mother's voice called my name. But Mother never called me 'Isabel'. Always 'Bel'. That wasn't Mother.
문 앞의 그것은 침묵의 왕이 세운 문지기다. 법전에 있었지. 이름을 부르: The thing before the door is the gatekeeper the King of Silence set there. It was in the Code: it lets no one live who speaks a name. It mimics the voices it swallowed. Elena's is in there too. Open the Memory Gate. It has no eyes. It finds you by sound.
Open the Memory Gate and put the gatekeeper warden to rest.
놈이 쓰러지며 삼켰던 목소리들이 한꺼번에 흩어졌다. 수백 명이 제 이름을: As it fell, the voices it had swallowed scattered all at once. Hundreds of people said their own name once and were gone. A page came out of the dirt before the door. "The eighth seat is empty. It was the seven who emptied it." …An eighth. The Chronicle has only seven.
A surveyor, are you. Oscar, fisherman. The archivist girl is sitting out on the dock. Third day without a word. She only talks by writing. I know how to sit by someone who won't speak. You cast a line. Catch a few cod and sit a while.
Catch 3 raw cod and bring them to Oscar.
아가씨가 종이를 내밀더군. '소리를 내면 누가 죽을 것 같아서요.' 그래: She held out a slip of paper. 'I feel someone will die if I make a sound.' So I told her the sea swallows every sound, it's safe here. …She laughed. Out loud. I light a lamp on the ice every night myself. Who am I waiting for? I'll tell you when the northern sea thaws.
마지막 끝은 허공일세. (장로가 엔더의 눈을 한 줌 건넨다. 장갑 위에서: The last end is the void. (The Elder hands over a fistful of ender eyes. On his glove they all look one way.) Throw these and they fly to the stronghold underground: a prison and a library built around the door to the void. Elena passed that door too. She did not pass the door back. When you see the library… no. See for yourself.
Find the stronghold with the ender eyes and examine the library shelves.
빈 서가를 보았군. …그 자리에 무슨 책이 있었느냐고? 나도 모르네. (: So you saw the empty shelf. …What books stood there? I don't know either. (He straightens his glove.) Truly. That one thing even I do not know. When you find the page bring it to me first. It will be too heavy for Isabel.
The void. Mother camped in a tower city on the outer islands, away from the dragon. She wrote a line on the wall each day. Fourteen days. Please read them in order. I… I'm coming this time. I haven't told the Elder.
Find an end city and examine Elena's camp records in order.
어머니는 용이 누구를 기다린다는 걸 알았어요. 그리고 용을 깨울 의식을: Mother knew the dragon was waiting for someone. And she was preparing the rite to wake it when… the record stops on the fourteenth day. The tower's scribes hide in boxes, believing that what is shut away isn't forgotten. …Who on earth were the people of this city?
Mother made three crystals and was one short. We'll make the fourth. An end crystal: glass, an ender eye, and a ghast tear. The weeping of Caldera's people goes into it. It's a rite to welcome someone home… so I think tears are right. Show me just one. Keep four more for the pedestal.
엔드 수정을 하나 만들어 기록관 이사벨에게 보여 주세요. (받침대 네 모: Craft one end crystal and show it to Isabel the archivist. (Keep four more for the corners of the pedestal.)
어머니가 그린 그대로예요. 허공의 용은 처음부터 싸우러 나와 있지 않아요: Just as Mother drew it. The dragon of the void isn't out fighting from the start. It sleeps on the pedestal, hard as stone. Place crystals on the four sides and it wakes. …Don't tell the Elder yet. I will read the last page first.
Waking the dragon. The archivist says it's no gatekeeper but a bound beast. Bound things are savage. They bite even the hand that frees them. Place the crystals on the four sides of the exit pedestal. The crystals on the towers heal it, break them first. The whole void is the battlefield, so the whole expedition goes. Only those who deal 10% of its health are counted. Heads… I'll count when you're back.
받침대에 수정을 놓아 허공의 용을 깨우고, 잠재워라 (최대 체력의 10%: Place the crystals to wake the dragon of the void, and put it to rest. (Deal at least 10% of its health.)
놈이 떨어지면서 울었다고? 길게, 한 번. 싸울 때 소리와 달랐다고. …: It cried out as it fell? Long, once. Not like its fighting roar. …The echo shard took the sound down. It's still trembling. A leather cover came out of the dirt under the pedestal. Elena's last page. I didn't open it. The archivist reads it first.
You brought the last page? …The Elder asked to see it first. No. I must read this first. Read it with me. This time I want to read to the end. After I write the dragon's name. I don't know its name, so I'll write what was seen.
어머니는 열나흘째 밤, 용이 잠든 틈에 페이지를 묻고 다시는 탑으로 돌아: On the fourteenth night, while the dragon slept, Mother buried the page and never made it back to the tower. …What became of the last line was your choice. Thank you. Either way. I'm not only a reader any more.
\"불을 지키고, 봉인을 지킨다. 그리고…\" 셋째 줄이 기억나지 않는다: "Guard the fire, guard the seals. And…" You can't recall the third line? Ha, never mind. That line was never there. Isabel will keep the last page? …Yes, that is right. (The gloved hand trembles for a moment.) Go and see the captain now. That map will weigh heavily on Roran.
조사대원님, 이것 좀 보세요. 허공의 야영지에서 어머니 짐을 챙겨 왔잖아: Surveyor, look at this. I brought Mother's things back from the camp in the void. There was a cracked crystal orb among them. Mia the apprentice screamed while polishing it. She saw a person in it, she said. Someone swinging a sword. Mia has never held a sword. Look into it with me.
Look into the crystal orb together with Isabel the archivist.
어머니 메모가 구슬 싼 천에 있었어요. '필경 탑의 상자 속 사람들이 건: There was a note of Mother's in the cloth around it. 'Handed to me by the people in the boxes of the scribes' tower. I don't know what it is. Hold a light to it and forgotten handiwork shows.' A mirror that reflects the skills of forgotten people, it seems. Who made it and why, I don't know. Set on a stand, anyone can look into it. So I had a stand raised in town and put it there. There is only the one, so I can't hand it out. But anyone may go and look. Handle it gently. It's cracked.
그 지도 이야기를 해야겠지. 스무 해 전, 수도회는 깨어나는 수호자들을: I owe you the story of that map. Twenty years ago the Order sent an expedition to look in on the waking guardians. Twelve of us. I was captain; Kael was my second, my closest friend. …I'm the only one who came back. The eleven red marks are where the others fell. One has been erased. Kael's.
이번엔 내가 간다. 다리가 이 꼴이어도 간다. 지옥이나 허공은 내가 모르: This time I go myself. Bad leg and all. Hell and the void were lands I didn't know. This is road I walked. Road I lost. Eleven name tags. If I bring back even one… no. I bring back all of them.
수첩의 첫 장: The First Page of the Logbook
첫 표시는 땅 밑 굴이다. 수첩 첫 장을 같이 봐라. 굴에는 그로틀이라는: The first mark is a cave underground. Read the logbook's first page with me. Grottols live down there, timid things that carry ore on their backs and swallow anything that shines. The tags will be in their bellies. They bolt at the sound of a pick, so go quietly.
로란과 함께 수첩의 첫 장을 살펴보고, 땅 밑 굴의 그로틀을 2마리 잡아: Examine the first page of the logbook with Roran, then catch 2 grottols underground.
토마스, 그리고 리아. 수첩에는 내 글씨로 '둘, 굴에서 길 잃음'이라고: Tomas, and Lia. In my own hand the log says only 'two, lost in the cave'. Wrong. Both tags came out of the same belly. They didn't get lost. One went back for the other. …For twenty years I've kept the wrong thing written down.
굴 끝에 녹슨 기사의 방이 있다. …솔직히 말하마. 스무 해 전 나는 그: At the end of the cave is the rusted knight's chamber. …I'll be honest. Twenty years ago I stood before that door and only watched the third one fall. Bren, our youngest. My leg locks up. I'm going anyway. Look hard at the doorway. Back then we were too busy fighting to see anything.
Find the wrought chamber underground and examine what is left before the door.
브렌의 명패다. 돌 틈에 끼어 있었다. (로란이 명패를 쥐고 한참 서 있: Bren's tag. Wedged between the stones. (Roran stands a long time holding it.) And those marks in the floor. So it hasn't taken one step in a thousand years. Facing forward. And we called it a 'monster'. Ask the smith. He's the one who reads armour.
녹슨 기사의 갑옷 조각이라고? 어디 보자. …이건 우리 집안 솜씨가 아니: A piece of the rusted knight's armour? Let's see. …This isn't my family's work. Far older. Flame Knights' make. Odd, though. Bring me some iron. If I hammer the same shape I'll know.
Bring 6 iron ingots to Bram the smith and hear how the armour was made.
알겠나. 앞판은 세 겹인데 등판은 한 겹이야. 실수가 아니야. 일부러 그: See? The front plate is three layers, the back one. That's no mistake. It was forged that way. Armour that trusted whoever would come up behind. Its lord was to return through the door at its back, so it left its back open. And striking that back is the only way. An ugly business.
강철의 기사. 이름은 호르스라더군. 천 년 동안 한 사람을 기다린 놈이다: The wrought knight. His name was Horus, they say. He waited a thousand years for one man. After the great swing of the axe his back is open. The back he left open. This time we have a Memory Gate. Put him to rest inside and the seal won't burst. If only we'd known twenty years ago. …Go. I'll stand at the door. This time I won't close my eyes.
Open the Memory Gate and put the wrought knight to rest.
놈이 쓰러지면서 처음으로 뒤를 돌아봤다고. 문 쪽을. 아무도 없는 걸 보: As he fell he looked back for the first time, you say. At the door. Saw no one there and sank down. …I know that feeling. Twenty years I watched the north road from the dock. He was no monster. He just waited. Like me.
호르스의 이름을 적었어요. 그런데 투구 안쪽에 길이 하나 그려져 있었어요: I wrote Horus's name. But inside the helm a path was drawn. I followed it and it leads to the Order's old proving ground, the Spiral Abyss. Clear the first floor and you are a full member of the Order. They say the Abyss shows the memories of those who passed through. The Flame remembers. The expedition passed through too, before it left.
무엇을 보셨어요? …원정대의 마지막 밤이요. 카엘이라는 분이 편지를 불에: What did you see? …The expedition's last night. The man called Kael holding a letter up to the fire. Then pressing the map into the captain's hands. A letter? What letter. …Don't tell the captain yet. Not until he brings it up himself.
두 번째 표시는 어두운 숲이다. 밤이면 랜턴이라는 빛나는 놈들이 떠다닌다: The second mark is the dark wood. At night glowing things called lanterns drift there. The log says 'Marco, lured into the swamp by the lights.' My handwriting. Kill them and you get glowing jelly. Shine it on the tree trunks. Let's see whether I wrote this one right.
어두운 숲의 랜턴을 3마리 물리쳐 빛나는 젤리 3개를 모으고, 그 빛으로: Defeat 3 lanterns in the dark wood to gather 3 glowing jelly, and shine that light on the tree trunks.
젤리 불빛에 나무마다 칼자국이 보였다고. 화살표다. 마르코는 홀린 게 아: Knife cuts on every tree, you say, in the jelly's light. Arrows. Marco wasn't lured. He marked his way as he walked. Hoping we'd follow. His tag was driven into the last trunk. …Wrong again. Twenty years I thought he died with his head in the clouds.
마르코의 화살표는 남쪽 정글로 이어진다. 거기 덩굴에 덮인 옛 사원이 있: Marco's arrows lead to the southern jungle. There's an old vine-covered temple there. Kael camped in it. He scribbled on every wall. I shouted at him for it. Defacing a ruin. …Let's read them. In the order he wrote them. Watch for foliaaths in the vines, man-eating flowers you don't see until you're close.
정글 사원을 찾아 카엘의 낙서 셋을 순서대로 살펴보고, 폴리아스를 3마리: Find a jungle temple, examine Kael's three scribbles in order, and defeat 3 foliaaths.
첫 낙서는 농담이었다. 둘째는 계산이었고. 셋째는… 나한테 하는 말이었다: The first was a joke. The second was arithmetic. The third… was to me. 'You go north.' He had already made up his mind in that temple to stay behind alone. What happened in between? What did you read, Kael.
바닷가 절벽 위를 나는 놈들이 있다. 나가. 날개 달린 바다뱀이다. 독을: There are things that fly over the sea cliffs. Nagas, winged sea serpents. They spit poison. They got Ines. In the log I wrote 'Ines, charged recklessly'. Bring me their fangs. I'll make a dagger. Ines fought with a single dagger.
(로란이 송곳니를 다듬어 단검을 만든다.) 절벽 아래 명패 옆에 화살통이: (Roran grinds the fangs into a dagger.) A quiver lay beside the tag under the cliff, you say. Empty. …She didn't charge recklessly. She shot until the arrows ran out and then drew the dagger. Until those of us behind her got clear. I need to rewrite the log. All of it.
오늘은 쉰다. 설원에 들어가기 전에 배를 채워야 한다. 구운 양고기와 달: Today we rest. We fill our bellies before the snowfields. Bring cooked mutton and sweet berries. The supper they liked best on the march. …I'll tell you about them while we eat. The things I never put in the log. Call the archivist too. She'll have things to write.
구운 양고기 4개와 달콤한 열매 6개를 가져와, 모닥불 곁에서 로란의 이: Bring 4 cooked mutton and 6 sweet berries, and listen to Roran by the campfire.
(이사벨이 손등이 새까매지도록 받아 적었다.) …이상하군. 스무 해 동안: (Isabel wrote until the back of her hand was black.) …Strange. For twenty years I remembered them as a number. Eleven. Now I've said it they're people. Tomas couldn't whistle. That's written down somewhere now.
로란이 직접 북쪽 설원으로 간다고 들었네. 그 다리로. …말릴 수 없겠지: I hear Roran is going to the northern snowfields himself. On that leg. …There's no stopping him. As it happens I have a request. A frost giant sleeps there holding a crystal of cold. To face fire we need a cold that can put fire to sleep. First find where the giant sleeps.
Find where the frost giant sleeps in the snowfields.
찾았군. 아이들의 그림도 보았나. …'금방 올게'라. 이 땅에는 그 말이: You found it. The giant sleeps deep. The crystal wakes when it feels fire. It will wake when you ember-bearers come near. …Tell Roran this. Don't look for Kael's sword in the snow. He won't find it. (The Elder did not say how he knew.)
설원의 표시는 셋이다. 다닐로, 요나, 페이. 수첩에는 '눈보라, 셋 실: Three marks in the snow. Danilo, Jonah, Fei. The log says 'blizzard, three missing'. We never found the bodies. But the hunters say that in a den deep in the snow the frozen dead stand in rows. As if someone stood them up. Let's go. They may be standing there.
설원의 은신처를 찾아 줄지어 선 얼음 해골들을 살펴보고, 얼어붙은 해골: Find the hideout in the snowfields, examine the rows of frozen dead, and defeat 2 frozen skeletons.
목도리 셋. 조사대 목도리다. 스무 해 동안 서 있었군. 누운 게 아니라: Three scarves. Corps scarves. Standing for twenty years. Not lying down. …A strange feeling. I should be angry. Someone stood them up, the ones I thought the snow had buried. So they wouldn't be covered. I need to see what did it.
스코르. 덮지 않는 자. 서리 왕국이 가르친 장의사다. 놈에게 우리는 도: That's the one. The hunters call it Skor. An old word for 'the one who does not cover'. A yeti. When it finds something frozen dead it carries it to the den and stands it up. It believes that what the snow covers is forgotten. To it we are thieves, come to take what it stood up. It is no guardian bound to a seal. No gate needed. Still, a captain collects his own tags. Clear the way.
설원의 은신처에서 예티 스코르를 잠재워라. (최대 체력의 10% 이상 피: In the snowfield hideout, put Skor the yeti to rest. (Deal at least 10% of its health.)
놈이 쓰러지기 전에 셋 앞을 막아섰다고. 마지막까지. …명패 셋을 거뒀다: Before it fell it stepped in front of those three, you say. To the last. …I took the three tags. I left the scarves. I left them standing. Beside the one that stood them up. Uncovered. (Roran strikes a line in the log and rewrites it. Over 'missing': 'gathered by Skor'.)
조사대원님, 대장님이 안 돌아오세요! 은신처 앞, 스무 해 전 셋을 잃은: Surveyor, the captain hasn't come back! He's sitting in front of the hideout, on the very spot where he lost three twenty years ago. And a blizzard is coming. I can't tell whether his leg is frozen and he can't get up, or he won't. Please take him a campfire and hot food. Please.
눈보라 속의 탐험대장 로란에게 모닥불 1개와 구운 소고기 6개를 가져다주: Take 1 campfire and 6 cooked beef to Captain Roran in the blizzard.
(Roran barely thaws his hands at the fire.) …It was here twenty years ago too. I lost three because there was no one to light a fire. I had the ember in my fist and my hands were too frozen to strike it. This time there's a fire. Because you're here. …To the giant. This time I'm not the one who waits.
거인을 잠재우고 얼음 결정을 가져오게. 기억의 문 너머에서 싸우면 설원이: Put the giant to rest and bring the ice crystal. Fight beyond a Memory Gate and the snowfield will not come down. When it draws breath, frost follows. Step aside. One day that crystal will matter very much. When fire is about to overtake someone.
Open the Memory Gate and put the giant that holds the ice to rest.
결정이 손 안에서 떨리는군. 불을 느끼는 게야. 잘 간직하게. 절대 팔아: The crystal trembles in your hand. It feels fire. Keep it safe. Never sell it. …No sword in the nest? I thought not. Kael never came to the snow. (Having said it the Elder fell silent a moment, like a man who has said too much.)
지도의 다음 표시는 높은 산꼭대기의 수도원이에요. 연대기에 '봉인을 돌에: The next mark is a monastery on a high peak. The Chronicle speaks of 'the mason who carved the seals in stone', who cut a marker for each of the seven seals. Tongbi the sculptor, heir to that craft, is still on the mountain. The patterns for those stones should be in the yard. Count them for me. There should be seven.
Find the mountaintop monastery and examine the stones in its yard.
여덟 개요? …연대기에는 일곱이라고 적혀 있어요. 여덟째 돌에만 이름이: Eight? …The Chronicle says seven. And only the eighth has no name. Not erased. Never carved. Like the empty shelf in the stronghold library. I must ask the mason himself. The captain… is at the foot of the mountain. He says he can't climb this one.
…나는 안 올라간다. 다리 때문이 아니다. 스무 해 전 저 산에서 둘을: …I'm not going up. It isn't the leg. Twenty years ago I lost two on that mountain. Hayun and Otto. They fell from the sculptor's pillars. I told them 'go up'. I only watched from below. If I stand there again I'll send someone up again.
(이사벨이 로란의 어깨에 손을 얹는다.) \"대장님이 올려 보내는 게 아: (Isabel lays a hand on Roran's shoulder.) "You aren't sending us up, Captain. We're climbing." …All right. Then this time I hold the rope at the bottom. Not just watch. If you fall, I catch you.
조각가 통비의 시험을 통과하세요. 솟아오르는 기둥을 오르며 균형을 잃지: Pass Tongbi the sculptor's trial. Climb the rising pillars and keep your balance. He looks for balance, not strength. When it's done, ask him about the eighth stone. The captain is holding the rope below.
\"여덟째 돌은 내 스승의 스승의 스승이 깎았다. 새길 이름을 들었는데,: "The eighth stone was cut by my master's master's master. He heard the name to carve, he said, and forgot it between picking up the chisel and striking.
