왜 자기는 안 나왔느냐고? 문틈이 사람 나올 만큼은 안 됐겠지. 아니면: Why didn't he come out himself, you ask? The gap wouldn't have been wide enough for a man. Or he couldn't leave the ninety-nine. I think it was the second. Smiths are like that. You don't abandon a hearth you've shared.
주문서 뒷면에 서명 대신 찍힌 망치 자국 하나, 봤나. 그게 그 사람 서: Did you see the single hammer mark stamped on the back of the order sheet in place of a signature? That's his signature. The only mark left by a man who carved no name.
장로 양반 장갑을 한 번 수선한 적이 있네. 손가락 끝이 해져서. 그런데: I mended the Elder's gloves once. The fingertips had worn through. The insides were scorched, though. The outsides were fine.
물어보니 '젊을 때 불에 덴 자리가 볕을 싫어한다'더군. 그런가 보다 했: When I asked, he said, 'A burn from my youth dislikes the sun.' I let it be. A smith doesn't pry about burns.
펠릭스는 걷다가 서서 지도를 고치네. 길이 열다섯 해 사이에 바뀌었다면서: Felix stops mid-stride to correct his map. Says the roads changed in fifteen years. In truth he's checking that his memory is right.
That fellow lived fifteen years in a cellar. He'd even forgotten how to hold a spoon. So bear with him if he's a little slow.
바다 위에 신전이 있다더군. 폭풍이 안 그치는 데. 거기 쇠는 천 년이: They say there's a temple on the sea. Where the storm never stops. They say the iron there doesn't rust in a thousand years. I'd like to see that once.
손님, 바다 위 신전 얘기 들어 보셨어요? 폭풍이 그치지 않는 데 있대요: Have you heard about the temple on the sea? It's where the storm never stops, they say. Someone's been waiting there for a ship for a thousand years, or so I hear.
바다 위 신전에 관한 소문이 있습니다. 폭풍이 그치지 않는 곳이라 합니다: There is a rumor of a temple on the sea. It is said to be where the storm does not cease. One coin from that place is held in our vault. No one has come to claim it.
The board is over there. Finish the job on any sheet you take down before you come back.
I used to be one of those taking the sheets down. My knees gave up before I did.
큰 놈을 노리기 전에 작은 놈부터 세어 보시오. 숫자가 손에 익어야 하오: Before you go after the big one, count the small ones first. The numbers have to settle into your hands.
하루치 종이와 한 주치 종이는 색이 다르오. 한 주치는 급하게 떼지 마시: A day's sheet and a week's sheet are different colors. Don't be hasty taking down a week's.
마을 밖에서 늘어난 것들을 줄여 달라는 종이요. 하루에 몇 장, 한 주에: These are requests to thin out what has multiplied outside the village. You can take so many a day and so many a week.
맡은 놈을 정해진 수만큼 잡으면 값은 그 자리에서 나가오. 여기까지 돌아: Bring down the set number of your mark and the pay goes out on the spot. No need to come back here.
싸우는 길을 걷는 이에게는 값을 조금 더 쳐 주오. 목숨 값이니 당연한: Those who walk the fighting path are paid a little more. It is the price of a life, so that is only fair.
이번 주 기록 보러 오셨어요? 장부는 거짓말을 안 해요. 한 주가 끝나면: Here to see this week's records? The ledger doesn't lie. When the week ends, the top three get prizes!
숫자가 올라가는 걸 보고 있으면 시간 가는 줄 몰라요. 하루 씨는 그게: I lose track of time watching the numbers go up. Haru says it's an illness.
The top row changes every week. That's what makes it fun.
저는 사람들끼리 주고받은 돈은 안 적어요. 그건 둘이서 얼마든지 부풀릴: I don't write down money people pass between themselves. Two people could puff that up as much as they liked.
종목마다 이번 주에 쌓은 것만 세요. 잡은 몬스터, 재운 수호자, 번 돈: Each category counts only what you built up this week. Monsters slain, guardians laid to rest, gold earned, gold spent, gold held, quests finished, bounties finished, expeditions completed.
어느 길을 걷든 똑같이 쌓을 수 있는 것만 골랐어요. 낚시꾼만 유리하면: I chose only things anyone can build up whatever path they walk. It wouldn't do for fishermen alone to have the edge.
한 주가 끝나면 종목마다 첫째부터 셋째까지 상이 나가요. 상은 저한테 와: When the week ends, first to third in each category get prizes. Come and collect them from me. I'll keep them for you.
First place may show a 'of the Week' title in front of their name for the next week. For that, go to Adele.
이름 앞에 무엇을 걸지는 스스로 정하시는 겁니다. 다만 하신 일만큼만 걸: What you set before your name is yours to decide. But you may set there only as much as you have done.
불은 이름을 먹는다고들 합니다. 그래도 한 일까지 먹지는 못합니다. 저는: They say the fire eats names. Even so, it cannot eat what was done. I write that down.
칭호는 빌려 드리는 것이 아닙니다. 이미 하신 일에 붙은 이름표를 찾아: A title is not something I lend. I only find the name plate that belongs to what you have already done.
높은 칭호를 얻으셨다고 낮은 칭호가 부끄러워지지는 않습니다. 처음 열 마: Earning a higher title does not make the lower one shameful. The first ten are always the hardest.
종목마다 쌓으신 만큼 칭호가 열립니다. 같은 종목의 칭호는 힘이 같고,: Titles open in each category according to what you have built up. Titles of the same category share one power, a little stronger the higher they are.
힘을 빌려 쓰는 칭호는 두 개까지 고르실 수 있습니다. 서로 다른 종목이: You may choose up to two titles whose power you use. They must be from different categories.
남에게 보이는 칭호는 하나입니다. 말씀하실 때 이름 앞에 걸립니다. 힘을: The title others see is one. It is set before your name when you speak. It may differ from the ones whose power you use.
단 한 사람, 수도회 장로님의 기록만 출발지 칸이 비어 있습니다. '먼: Only one person, the Elder of the Order, has an empty place-of-departure column in his record. It says only 'posted from a distant chapter.'
시청 옛 장부에 이상한 항목이 하나 있습니다. '새벽의 섬 함대 입항 예: There is one odd entry in the town hall's old ledger. 'Fleet of the Isle of Dawn due in port. Prepare the welcome.' There is no date. Nor any record that it was cancelled.
어서 와~ (럭키가 창 쪽을 흘끔 보고는 영수증 뭉치를 서랍에 밀어 넣는: Welcome~ (Lucky glances at the spear and shoves a bundle of receipts into a drawer.) No, nothing at all! What'll you pull today?
앗, 그거! 그게 나왔구나! …저기, 그거 어디서 났는지 묻지 말아 줄래: Ah, that! So that one came out! …Um, would you mind not asking where it came from? I don't know either, that's why!
제일 깊은 데 숨은 그거? 본 사람은 손에 꼽는다구. 이름도 안 알려 줄: The one hidden deepest of all? You can count on one hand the people who've seen it. I won't even tell you its name. But you, maybe?
솔직히 말할게. 그건 내가 들여온 물건이 아니라구. 어느 날 상품 더미: I'll be honest. I didn't bring that one in. One day it was at the very bottom of the stock pile. Somebody left it with me, and I can't remember the face.
얼굴만이 아니야. 목소리도, 키도. 영수증은 있다구. 여기. 근데 글씨가: Not just the face. The voice, the height. I do have the receipt, though. Here. But the writing is backwards. You have to hold it to a mirror to read it.
'불이 다시 굶주리기 전에, 이 불을 받아들일 손에 닿게 하라. 값은 치: 'Before the fire hungers again, let this fire reach a hand that will accept it. Paid in full.' …It's not me who decides who accepts it, it's luck! So I put it in the gacha. I'm a merchant, not a judge.
조사대원에게는 몇 가지 도구가 있습니다. 모두 손에 들고 우클릭해서 씁니:
A surveyor has a few tools. All are used by holding them and right-clicking.

· Surveyor's Codex: records the mobs you met, the mobs you slew and the gear you obtained.
· Surveyor's Guidebook: the book you are reading now.
· Survey Compass: shows the direction and distance of the place your current quest is looking for.
· Return Ticket: takes you back to town. (See the 'Return tickets' page.)
· Weapon Manual: you receive one the first time you obtain a weapon with a special skill.

You receive one Codex and one Guidebook at the start. If you lose them, the general store sells them again.
마을 사람을 우클릭하면 대화 상자가 열립니다.\n\n· 맨 위 선택지는:
Right-click a townsperson to open the dialogue box.

· The top choice is that person's own work (shop, bank, jobs, attendance, gacha…).
· A story marked '✦' is one you have not heard yet.
· [Quests] shows the quests you can take and the ones in progress.
· [Talk history] lets you reread what has been said so far.

Chat with the same person long enough and now and then they let slip something you cannot hear anywhere else.
퀘스트는 NPC 와의 대화에서 받습니다. 목표를 채운 뒤 다시 찾아가면:
Quests are taken in conversation with NPCs. Fill the goals, go back, and you receive the reward.

· Quest journal: /rtshop quest (you can bind a key in the controls)
· You can have 10 in progress at once, and an abandoned quest can be taken again.
· The quest display on screen shows each goal's progress and whom to visit.
· Only one combat job quest line and one life job quest line can be in progress at a time.
/rtshop hud 를 치면 Gold, 퀘스트, PvP 표시를 마우스로:
Type /rtshop hud to drag the Gold, quest and PvP displays with the mouse.

· Click a display to select it, then change its size, font and text size.
· Tab selects the next display and the arrow keys nudge it.
· Each display can be switched on or off.
쓰러지면 지갑에 든 Gold 의 일부를 잃습니다. 은행에 맡긴 돈은 잃지:
When you fall you lose part of the Gold in your wallet. Money kept in the bank is not lost.

· Gold checks you carry lose value at the same rate.
· If you fall fighting a story boss, you lose no Gold.
· Without a bed or respawn anchor, you rise again at the town's home point.

Leave large sums in the bank before you set out.
잡화점에서 삽니다. 손에 들고 우클릭을 3초 동안 누르고 있으면 마을의:
Sold at the general store. Hold one and keep right-click pressed for 3 seconds to go back to the town's home point.

· Return Ticket: works only within 10,000 blocks of town, measured flat (height is not counted).
· Greater Return Ticket: works anywhere. Only so many can be bought per day (5 by default).
· Neither works inside the raid zone or a Memory Gate.
· /rtshop quest : 퀘스트 수첩\n· /rtshop hud:
· /rtshop quest : quest journal
· /rtshop hud : move the on-screen displays
· /rtshop balance : see wallet and savings
· /rtshop check <amount> : write a Gold check
· /rtshop land : my land settings
· /rtshop job : see my jobs
· /party : party (create, invite, leave)
· /pc <text> : party chat
· /pvp : turn PvP on or off
· /bounty : see the bounties I took
돈은 지갑과 예금, 두 군데에 있습니다. 물건을 사고팔 때는 지갑의 돈을:
Your money sits in two places: wallet and savings. Buying and selling uses the wallet.

· Talk to the banker to deposit and withdraw.
· Savings do not shrink when you fall.
· /rtshop check <amount> turns wallet money into a Gold check. Whoever receives it right-clicks with it in hand and the money goes into their wallet.
상인마다 다루는 물건이 다릅니다. 창 위쪽에서 사기와 팔기를 바꿉니다.\:
Each merchant handles different goods. Switch between buying and selling at the top of the window.

· Mod weapons, armor, tools and trinkets cannot be crafted. Get them from shops or the gacha.
· Staves are sold by the blacksmith.
· Things that only bosses drop are not in any shop. You must win them yourself.
· Things you pulled from the gacha cannot be sold to shops (dismantle them into shards instead).
잡화점에서 「플레이어 상점 진열대」를 사서 놓으면 내 가게가 됩니다.\n:
Buy a 'Player Shop Stand' at the general store and place it, and it becomes your shop.

· Right-click the stand to put up goods from your bag and set a price and quantity.
· What customers pay goes into your savings even while you are offline.
· A clerk stands beside the stand. The clerk is paid a wage every day; if you cannot pay, the shop rests that day.
· Anything at all can be put up in a player shop.
식당 주인에게는 요리사만 요리를 팔 수 있습니다. 식품 상인보다 조금 더:
Only cooks can sell dishes to the restaurant owner, who pays a little more than the food merchant.

· The restaurant sells nothing at first.
· A dish a cook has sold even once goes on the menu, and anyone can buy what is on the menu.
씨앗은 농작물 상인에게서 산 것만 심을 수 있습니다. 작물을 거둬도 씨앗:
Only seeds bought from the crop merchant can be planted. Harvesting a crop gives no seeds.

· For crops that are their own seed, like carrots and potatoes, buy the separate 'planting only' item.
· Right-click a fully grown crop to harvest it. If the same seed is in your bag, it is replanted for you.
· A better hoe harvests a wide area at once (crouch for a single block).
· Crops you grew and harvested yourself get a star grade, and more stars sell for more.
씨앗 작물 수확 별 등급 괭이: seed crop harvest star grade hoe
낚은 물고기는 수산물 상인이 삽니다. 희귀할수록, 무거울수록 값이 높습니:
The fish merchant buys what you catch. The rarer and the heavier, the higher the price.

Kinds of fish and how to catch them are in the fishing mod's own guide.
식품 상인은 식재료를 팔고, 만든 음식을 사 줍니다.\n\n· 팬·찜기·:
The food merchant sells ingredients and buys finished food.

· Food made by hands-on cooking (pan, steamer, kettle) is bought for more.
· Even if you buy every ingredient at the shops and sell what you make, you do not lose money.
· Hover over a food in the shop to see the ingredients its price is based on.
· The cook job sells hand-made dishes for more.
전투 직업 하나와 생활 직업 하나를 가질 수 있습니다. 직업 안내인에게서:
You can hold one combat job and one life job. Choose and change them at the job guide.

· Each job needs its quest line finished first. The job guide gives the first step and that job's teacher gives the rest.
· The first choice is free. Changing costs money and cannot be done again for a while.
· /rtshop job shows your current jobs and traits.
전투 직업은 무기 종류마다 피해와 공격 속도가 오르거나 내려갑니다. 자기:
A combat job raises or lowers damage and attack speed by weapon type. You are strong with your own kind of weapon and clumsy with others.

· A weapon's description names its type (sword, axe, spear, bow, staff…).
· Only those who walk the mage's path can use magic.
· Without a combat job there are no such bonuses or penalties.
강화 모루는 마을에 하나뿐입니다. 모루를 우클릭하고 장비를 올리면 옆의:
There is only one enhance anvil in town. Right-click it and place your gear; the panel beside it shows the odds, materials and Gold.

· The result is one of success (+1), no change, damage (-1) or destruction. It gets harder as the level rises.
· Right-click a guard ticket in hand beforehand and the next single attempt is protected.
· Enhanced gear shows +N before its name and gains attack or defense.
행운 상인에게서 무기·펫·장신구를 뽑습니다. 티켓은 뽑기 창의 티켓 상점:
Pull weapons, pets and trinkets from the luck merchant. Tickets are bought with Gold in the ticket shop inside the gacha window.

· 'Odds table' shows the chance of every single item.
· What you pull cannot be sold to shops. 'Dismantle' gives shards, and 'Shard exchange' trades them for the item you want.
· Pets come as summon tickets. Right-click the ground and the pet appears already tamed.
티켓 조각 분해 교환 펫 장신구: ticket shard dismantle exchange pet trinket
룬 제단에서는 룬석을 골라 마법을 뽑습니다.\n\n· 룬석을 만지면 분야:
At the rune altar you choose a rune stone and draw magic.

· Touch a rune stone to choose a field, touch the summoning sigil to draw.
· Place gear on the altar and touch the blue sigil to reroll its enchantments.
· The odds by grade are shown in the panel beside the altar. On a failure nothing comes out.
몬스터 처치, 보스 처치, 수익, 소비, 보유 Gold, 퀘스트, 현상금:
Monsters slain, bosses slain, earnings, spending, Gold held, quests, bounties, raids. Titles open in each category as you build it up.

· Choose them at the title keeper.
· Up to two titles lend their power (from different categories). Titles of one category share an effect, a little stronger the higher they are.
· One title is shown. It appears before your name when you speak.
순위 기록원이 종목마다 이번 주 기록으로 순위를 매깁니다.\n\n· 한:
The ranking clerk ranks everyone by this week's record in each category.

· When the week ends, the top three of each category get rewards. Collect them from the clerk.
· First place may show an 'of the Week' title for the next week.
· Earnings and spending count only money made and spent at shops, quests and the like. Money passed between people is not counted.
시청 서기에게 말을 걸면 출석부가 열립니다. 하루에 한 번 출석하면 그날:
Talk to the town clerk to open the attendance book. Check in once a day for that day's reward.

· Weekly rewards depend on how many days you checked in that week.
· If your streak breaks, the first time is forgiven. After that it starts over.
· A 'restore ticket' from the attendance shop brings back a broken streak.
현상금 게시판에서 토벌 의뢰를 맡습니다. 하루에 몇 장, 한 주에 몇 장:
Take hunting requests at the bounty board. You can take so many a day and so many a week.

· Bring down the set number of the mob and you are paid Gold on the spot.
· Those with a fighting job are paid a little more.
· /bounty shows the requests you took.
토지 상인에게서 문서를 사서, 마을 밖 원하는 곳에서 우클릭하면 내 땅이:
Buy a deed from the land merchant and right-click where you like outside town to make it your land.

· Holding a deed shows the area it would claim (green = allowed, red = not).
· Used next to your own land, it joins on and widens it.
· Your land is protected from a few blocks below your feet up to the sky.
· 'Return land' in the land settings gives the deed back.
/rtshop land 로 내 땅의 설정을 엽니다.\n\n· 모두에게 또:
/rtshop land opens the settings of your land.

· For everyone or per person, you can grant placing, breaking, storage, doors and levers, and animals separately.
· Open a chest on your land and a 'Set PIN' button appears above it. With a PIN set, anyone but the owner must enter the number to open it.
마을 안의 땅은 미리 나뉜 구획으로 삽니다. 토지 상인의 창에서 지도를:
Land inside town is bought as plots that were divided beforehand. Pick one on the map in the land merchant's window.

· Before buying you can preview 'as it is now' and 'after buying.'
· Buying a plot clears away the trees and old buildings on it.
/party create 로 만들고 /party invite <이름> 으:
Create one with /party create and invite with /party invite <name>.

· Party members cannot hurt each other, and their health is shown on screen.
· Members nearby share progress on mob-slaying quest goals.
· For bosses, only those who personally dealt a set share of the health are credited with the kill.
· /pc <text> talks to party members only.
마을에서는 누구도 PvP 를 할 수 없습니다. 마을 밖에서는 PvP 를:
No one can PvP inside town. Outside town, only those who both have PvP on can hurt each other.

· Turn it on and off with /pvp. It can be turned on only where PvP is allowed.
· Right after hitting or being hit you cannot turn it off for a moment.
· The PvP display on screen shows your state and what kind of place you are in.
레이드 안내인에게 말을 걸어 들어갑니다. 참가 티켓은 레이드 상인이 팝니:
Talk to the raid guide to enter. Entry tickets are sold by the raid merchant.

· On entering you receive a 'Summoning Eye' and an 'Escape Ticket.' Use the Eye on the altar to wake the boss.
· During a raid, falling costs you no items or Gold; you become a spectator.
· The weekly reward comes with that week's first success. After that the boss's drops are still rolled.
· A raid opens only after you have beaten that boss at least once.
Spiral Abyss 의 층 선택 화면 왼쪽 아래에 이번 주 보상이 나:
This week's rewards are shown at the lower left of the Spiral Abyss floor selection screen.

· You receive a floor's reward the moment you clear it. Once a week per floor.
· [Details] shows each floor's rewards and chances.
무기를 들고 전투 모드로 바꾸면 공격을 이어 누를 때 연속 공격이 나갑니:
Switch to battle mode with a weapon in hand and pressing attack in succession chains a combo. To mine blocks, the same key returns you to mining mode.

· The keys for switching mode, dodging, guarding and special skills are under Epic Fight in the controls.
· Every weapon has its own combo and special skill. Open its 'Weapon Manual' to read how it is used.
· /rtshop manual gives you the manual of the weapon in your hand again.
전투 모드 구르기 막기 특수기 콤보: battle mode dodge guard special skill combo
Epic Fight 의 고급 무기들입니다. 대장장이가 팔지만 값이 매우:
High-end weapons for Epic Fight. The blacksmith sells them, at a very high price.

Each has its own combo and special skill, so be sure to open its weapon manual.
주문서에 주문을 새겨 쓰는 마법입니다. 마법사의 길을 걷는 사람만 쓸 수:
Magic cast from spells inscribed in a spell book. Only those who walk the mage's path can use it.

· Casting costs mana. Mana refills over time.
· Ink is not sold in shops. Monsters drop it now and then, and bosses drop better ink more often.
· Staves are bought from the blacksmith.
주문 마나 잉크 두루마리 주문서: spell mana ink scroll spell book
마법사·성기사 같은 RPG 시리즈의 지팡이와 주문서입니다.\n\n· 주문:
Staves and spell books of the RPG Series, such as Wizards and Paladins.

· Put a spell book in the spell book slot, then hold a staff, choose a spell and cast it.
· Casting costs mana. Without mana nothing is cast.
· Staves cannot be crafted. Buy them from the blacksmith.
보스에게서만 나오는 물건은 상점에서 사고팔 수 없습니다. 직접 잡아서 얻:
Things only bosses drop cannot be bought or sold in shops. You win them yourself.

· Hover over something a boss dropped and that boss's story is attached.
· Story bosses are fought inside a 'Memory Gate.' Falling in there costs no Gold.
· The Codex records the stats and drops of bosses you have beaten.
장신구와 펫은 상자나 몬스터에게서 나오지 않습니다. 뽑기로 얻습니다.\n:
Trinkets and pets do not come from chests or monsters. They come from the gacha.

· Trinkets go in the trinket slots (the trinket button on the inventory screen).
· Use a pet summon ticket on the ground and the pet appears already tamed.
요리 모드의 도마·팬·솥·찜기 같은 조리 도구로 음식을 만듭니다.\n\n:
Make food with the cooking mods' tools, such as the cutting board, pan, pot and steamer.

· See recipes by clicking a food in the recipe viewer (JEI).
· Food made by hands-on cooking is bought for more by the food merchant.
· Cooking ingredients no shop used to sell are sold automatically by the food merchant.
요리 도마 팬 솥 JEI 조리법: cooking cutting board pan pot JEI recipe
Welcome, new adventurer. I'll teach you, one thing at a time, how to stay alive in this land.
검은 정직한 무기다. 휘두른 만큼만 돌려주지. 배울 각오가 됐나?: The sword is an honest weapon. It gives back exactly as much as you swing. Are you ready to learn?
하하! 덩치 좋은 녀석이 왔군. 도끼 한 자루면 세상 무서울 게 없지!: Ha ha! A sturdy one has come. With one axe in hand there's nothing in the world to fear!
The one who stands before their comrades must be the last to fall. That is a keeper's work.
Shh, listen to the wind. You shoot a bow with your ears more than your eyes.
Mana is not only inside books, you know. It is scattered all through the world.
잿불 수도회 견습 서약: Apprentice's Oath of the Order of Embers
하나. 불을 지킨다.\n둘. 봉인을 지킨다.\n셋. ――――――――\n\:
One. Guard the flame.
Two. Guard the seals.
Three. ――――――――

(The third line has been erased.)
One. Guard the flame.
Two. Guard the seals.
Three. When the time comes, let go.

(The third line that was erased. This is how the original oath read.)
되찾은 페이지 곁에 기록관이 적어 넣은 이름들: Names the archivist wrote in beside the recovered pages
아직 적힌 이름이 없다.\n\n이야기를 따라가면 기록관 이사벨이 한 줄씩:
No names are written yet.

Follow the story and Archivist Isabel will write them in, one line at a time.
블레이즈 불빛 아래에서만 드러나는 글: Writing that shows only under blaze light
백지에 떠오른 글: Words that rose on the blank page
이사벨에게. 이 글을 읽는다면 나는 돌아가지 못한 것이다. 남은 페이지는:
To Isabel. If you are reading this, I could not come home. I hid the pages at the three ends.

Beside the black star in the burning fortress, before the gate of the soundless city, beneath the dragon at the end of the void.

The Chronicle did not fall apart from age. Someone cut it in order to rewrite it. I saw one page from before it was rewritten.
첫째 끝 · 불타는 요새: The first end · the burning fortress
요새는 성이 아니라 둑이다. 명령판 셋을 읽으면 검은 별이 무엇인지 안다: The fortress is not a castle but a dike. Read the three order slabs and you will know what the Black Star is.
「세 머리의 서약」\n\n방벽이 뚫리면 세 대장의 머리를 영혼 모래 위에:
'The Oath of Three Heads'

When the wall is breached, set the three captains' heads upon soul sand.
Deep dark underground, the city where sound dies. I buried a page before the gate.
벨. 연대기의 페이지를 사는 사람은 회색 망토를 입는다. 나는 그를 안다:
Isabel. The one who buys the Chronicle's pages wears a grey cloak. I know him. The one who always sat on the side far from the campfire.

It was not fire that cut the Chronicle, but a human hand. That hand wears…

(The last line is folded over.)

Isabel. The one who buys the Chronicle's pages wears a grey cloak. I know him. The one who always sat on the side far from the campfire.

It was not fire that cut the Chronicle, but a human hand. That hand wears a glove.
구석의 서명: 로란, 카엘: Signed in the corner: Roran, Kael
붉은 표시가 열한 개 찍혀 있다.\n하나만 지워져 있다.\n\n구석에 서:
Eleven red marks.
Only one has been erased.

Two signatures in the corner. One hand upright, the other playfully slanted.
붉은 표시 열한 개는 대원들이 쓰러진 자리다.\n지워진 하나는 카엘의 자:
The eleven red marks are where the members fell.
The one erased is Kael's.
토마스 · 리아 · 브렌 · 마르코 · 이네스\n다닐로 · 요나 · 페이:
Thomas · Lia · Bren · Marco · Ines
Danilo · Jonah · Fei · Hayun · Otto

Kael, second in command. The one who vanished to save a friend

And Roran, captain. The one who came back and counted heads
얼음이 박혀 펼쳐지지 않는다.\n\n급히 녹이면 잉크가 번진다. 기록관:
Ice is lodged in it and it will not open.

Thaw it fast and the ink runs. Archivist Isabel is thawing it slowly.
항로를 산 날: The day the route was bought
회색 망토의 학자가 왔다. '여덟 번째 눈이 있는 곳'이라며 항로를 내밀:
A scholar in a grey cloak came. He held out a route, saying it led to 'where the eighth Eye lies.' He said a power to bring back what is forgotten was there. He knew of the Morning Star. He spoke the names of the thirty-two. Names I have never once told another soul.

The price was the price of a ship. And one request. 'When you reach it, write down what you hear and bring it back.' When I asked what would be heard, he only smiled. He was wearing gloves. In high summer.
항로 끝에서 폭풍을 만났다. 폭풍이 배를 감쌌다. 부수지 않았다. 들여다:
At the end of the route we met the storm. It wrapped around the ship. It did not break her. It looked in. One person at a time. Then someone dropped the anchor. A bell rang. The crew began to fall. Not from the cold. From the bell.

Someone under the sea asked what I would ask for. I asked. When the Morning Star went down there had been no one to ask.
글이 아니라 약도다. 선장실 바닥 널 밑.\n\n(풀로 붙여 숨겨 둔 쪽:
Not writing but a sketch map. Under the floorboards of the captain's cabin.

(A page glued shut and hidden.)
지갑에 접혀 있던 쪽지: A note folded in her purse
항로 끝에서 폭풍이 배를 들여다볼 것이오. 해치지 않소.\n\n그때 폭풍:
At the end of the route the storm will look into your ship. It will do no harm.

Then someone in the storm will call a name. A person's name. Perhaps only once. Write it down and bring it to me. Not one letter wrong.

For that single name I will return the whole price of the route.
(The signature is not letters but a drawing. A gloved hand.)
쪽지 뒷면 · 선장의 글씨: Back of the note · in the captain's hand
이름은 못 들었다. 폭풍은 아무 이름도 부르지 않았다. 부르려다 만 것: I heard no name. The storm called no name at all. It seemed about to, and stopped. Like someone who does not know the name to call.
베스탈리아 연대기 · 마지막 장: The Chronicle of Vestalia · The Last Page
불을 지키고, 봉인을 지키고, 그리고 때가 되어 놓아주었다.\n\n조사대:
We kept the Flame, we kept the seals, and when the time came we let go.

Written in the name of every surveyor, one by one.
Everyone who came on the seventeen ships.

Written in the ink of ash. Fire cannot eat it.
잡화점에서 삽니다. 손에 들고 우클릭을 3초 동안 누르고 있으면 마을의:
Sold at the general store. Hold one and keep right-click pressed for 3 seconds to go back to the town's home point.

· Return Ticket: works only within 3,000 blocks of town, measured flat (height is not counted). After one use it can be used again in 1 hour.
· Greater Return Ticket: works anywhere. After one use it can be used again in 30 minutes. Only so many can be bought per day (5 by default).
· The waiting time runs on real time, and the two tickets count separately. Right-click a ticket that is not ready yet to see the time left.
· Neither works inside the raid zone or a Memory Gate.
마을 사람을 우클릭하면 대화 상자가 열립니다.\n\n· 맨 위 선택지는:
Right-click a townsperson to open the dialogue box.

· The top choice is that person's own work (shop, bank, jobs, attendance, gacha…).
· A story marked '✦' is one you have not heard yet.
· [Quests] shows the quests you can take and the ones in progress.
· [Talk history] lets you reread what has been said so far.

Chat with the same person long enough and now and then they let slip something you cannot hear anywhere else.

Anyone you have spoken to once, and any place you have visited, stays on the map (Diorama) by name. To bring back a mark you deleted from the map, use /rtshop mapmark resend.
대화 선택지 이야기 지도 표시: talk dialogue choices stories map marks waypoints
그 한 줄에는 엘레나부터 적었어요. 카엘과 원정대 열 명, 코넬리아의 삼: In that one line I wrote Elena first. Kael and the ten of the expedition, Cornelia's three hundred and thirty-two. I wrote small in case the ash ran out.
자네, 이곳은 처음이지? 모험을 하려면 돈을 어디에 맡길지부터 알아야 하: New here, are you? Before you go adventuring you need to know where to keep your money. Go and say hello to the town's banker. You lose part of the money you carry when you die, so it's safer to deposit it.
The banker is the middle-aged clerk in town. Go and have a word.
So you've met the banker. That's one less worry about money. It isn't much, but here's some pocket money.
다음은 농사일세. 농작물 상인에게서 밀 씨앗을 사서 밭에 심고, 자란 밀: Next is farming. Buy wheat seeds from the Crop Merchant, plant them in a field, then harvest the grown wheat and bring it to me. Mind that only seeds bought at the shop can be planted.
Bring 8 wheat. The Crop Merchant has the seeds.
Fine wheat! Money earned by your own sweat is worth the most.
밤이 되면 몬스터가 나타나네. 무기를 챙겨서 몬스터 5마리를 처치하고 오: Monsters come out at night. Take a weapon, defeat 5 monsters and come back. Don't push yourself. There's no shame in running when it's dangerous.
Defeat 5 monsters. Any kind will do.
You made it back safe. You're a proper adventurer now.
마지막으로, 자네만의 땅이 있어야 하지 않겠나? 토지 상인을 찾아가 토지: Last of all, shouldn't you have land of your own? Find the Land Merchant and ask about land deeds. Then come back and tell me which road you want to walk.

Story places come in three kinds. Each one opens only while you are on the quest that sends you there.

· Traces: things to look at. A pillar of light and a ring on the ground that only you can see. (See 'Looking at traces'.)
· The Memory Gate: the room where you fight a story boss. It is not a door you walk through; you enter with a button. (See 'The Memory Gate'.)
· Far-off structures: hold the Survey Compass and right-click for the direction and distance. It only points to places that really exist, more than 1000 blocks from town.

The '➤ about N blocks to the …' line on the quest display is where the person or trace you should go to now is.

A boss the story has not reached yet is behind a ward. If you are pushed back, do the quests before it first.

「살펴보게」 같은 목표는 흔적을 찾아 들여다보는 일입니다. 수업 때의 연:
A goal such as 'take a look' means finding a trace and looking into it. The practice Memory Gate from your first lesson is a trace too.

· When you take the quest, a notice says 'Something nearby is worth a closer look' and the trace appears 5 to 12 blocks away.
· A trace that belongs to a structure appears when you reach that structure.
· Traces that come in order appear after you have looked at the one before.
· Walk to the pillar of light and look at it from within 4 blocks: 'Look closer' shows up. Right-click.
· The goal is filled only when you turn the text to its end.
· A trace stays where it first appeared. If you have wandered off, follow the '➤' on the quest display back to it.
· If it landed somewhere you cannot reach, give the quest up and take it again: the trace appears next to you anew.
· Nobody else can see it, and it cannot be broken or moved.

· You do not lose Gold if you fall inside. Press the button again to retry.
· Return tickets cannot be used inside.

돌 옆에 아이 글씨로 덧새긴 줄: \"물 부르는 손님이 지나가면 사흘 뒤: Beside the stone, a line added in a child's hand: "When the guest who calls the water passes, grass comes up three days later. Don't build houses on the guest's road. Don't wake the guest. The guest is working."
가장 아래, 칼로 급히 그은 새 줄이 하나 있다. 스무 해쯤 됐다. 삐뚠: At the very bottom is one new line, cut hastily with a knife. About twenty years old. Crooked letters: "The next stretch is the middle of the caravan road. Told the village. Told them to move the road. — a passerby"
탐험대장 로란: …카엘 글씨다. 놈은 가로지르면서 이걸 읽고, 다음에 꺼: Captain Roran: …That's Kael's handwriting. He read this on his way across, worked out where the ground would sink next, warned the village, and went on. On a road he was walking alone, like a hunted man.
The desert village. We filled our water here during the expedition, too. The well is over there.
The stones around the well. Covered in marks. This is what the old man was talking about.
길은 사는 사람한테 묻는 거다. 스무 해 전에 끝까지 들었어야 했다. 가: You ask the people who live there about the road. I should have heard them out twenty years ago. Let's go.
굴 벽의 수로 도면: Waterway Plans on the Tunnel Wall
굴 벽이 이상하게 반듯하다. 무너진 굴이 아니라 다듬은 통로다. 벽을 따: The tunnel walls are strangely straight. Not a collapsed tunnel but a finished passage. A channel is cut along the wall, and its bed is white with scale. Water once ran here.
벽에 돌판이 박혀 있다. 선과 눈금. 수로의 설계 도면이다. 구간마다 표: A stone slab is set into the wall. Lines and gradations. The design for a waterway. Each section bears a mark: one claw scratch for every section dug. Thousands of them.
\"사막의 왕 아므라트의 명. 물길을 왕의 정원까지 잇는다. 굴착은 왕의: "By order of Amrat, King of the Desert. The waterway shall be joined to the king's garden. The digging is entrusted to the king's beast, Sirok." Sirok, in the old tongue, means 'that which calls the water.'
도면의 마지막 구간, '왕의 정원'에는 발톱 자국이 없다. 그 앞 구간까: The last section on the plan, 'the king's garden,' has no claw scratch. Everything up to the section before it has been dug. Where the garden stood is under the sand. The beast has been digging for a thousand years toward a last section it can never reach.
물 창고의 벽 그림: Wall Painting in the Water Store
아래 방 벽에 그림이 여섯 칸 이어져 있다. 첫 칸: 왕이 작은 벌레 한: A painting runs across the wall of the lower room in six panels. The first: the king holds a single small worm in both hands. The worm drinks the water in his palm.
둘째, 셋째 칸: 벌레가 자란다. 왕이 지팡이로 모래에 선을 긋고, 벌레: The second and third panels: the worm grows. The king draws a line in the sand with his staff, and the worm digs along it. Water flows where it has dug. A village appears. Each time a section is done, the king pours it a jar of water.
넷째 칸: 하늘이 잿빛이다. 일곱 사람이 불 앞에 서 있고, 왕이 그쪽으: The fourth panel: the sky is ash grey. Seven people stand before a fire, and the king walks toward them. He looks back and beckons to the beast. Beneath it, the words: "I will wait in the garden. The day the water reaches it, I will open the gate for you. Until then, do not stop your work, Sirok."
다섯째 칸: 왕이 눈 하나를 들고 돌아온다. 그런데 그림 속 왕국이 반쯤: The fifth panel: the king returns carrying an eye. But the kingdom in the painting is half sunk in sand. The price of receiving the eye. The king goes in through the garden gate, and sand closes over the gate.
여섯째 칸은 다른 손이 훨씬 뒤에 그렸다. 서툴다. 짐승 혼자 파고 있다: The sixth panel was painted much later by another hand. It is clumsy. The beast digs alone. Beside it, small people carrying water jars. The villagers. For generations they poured the water in the king's place.
시로크, 물을 부르는 것\n왕의 정원까지 물길을 이으라는 명을 천 년 수:
Sirok, that which calls the water
Carried out for a thousand years the order to join the waterway to the king's garden. Work complete.
탐험대장 로란: 토마스는 휘파람을 못 불었다. 바람 소리만 났지. 리아가: Captain Roran: Thomas couldn't whistle. All that came out was wind. When Lia imitated it, the whole camp laughed.
Captain Roran: Bren never took his boots off to sleep. So he could run at any moment. The youngest was the most afraid, and the first to stand in front.
탐험대장 로란: 마르코와 다닐로는 형제다. 마르코는 길눈이 밝았고 다닐로: Captain Roran: Marco and Danilo are brothers. Marco had a good sense of direction and Danilo the opposite. So Danilo always walked behind his little brother.
Captain Roran: Ines had no fear. No, she had it, she just never showed it. Jonah never said a word, and Fei did the talking for both of them.
탐험대장 로란: 하윤은 높은 데를 좋아했다. 오토는 노래를 잘했지. 하윤: Captain Roran: Hayun liked high places. Otto could sing. When Hayun climbed, Otto would sing to her from below. So she wouldn't lose the way back down.
Captain Roran: …Every time I counted heads, Kael hid one person behind him. To watch me panic. That's how I got the habit of counting twice. It's his fault.
거인이 누운 얼음 바닥 아래에 무언가 비친다. 얼기 전에 바닥에 그린 것: Something shows beneath the ice floor where the giant lies. It was drawn on the floor before it froze. Clumsy lines. A children's drawing.
큰 흰 짐승 하나와 그 등에 올라탄 작은 사람 여럿. 짐승은 웃는 얼굴로: One big white beast with several small people riding on its back. The beast is drawn with a smiling face. Beside it, crooked letters: "Our bear. Haven't decided on a name yet."
그림 한쪽에 다른 색으로 덧그린 것이 있다. 아이들이 짐승에게 빛나는 돌: Something has been added to one side of the drawing in a different color. The children hold a glowing stone out to the beast. The letters are hurried: "They say the king is turning to ice. They say we'll freeze too. This is a cold stone. If the fire comes, put it out with this. You keep it. We'll be right back."
거인은 그 그림 위에 엎드려 잔다. 품 안쪽에서 희미하게 푸른 빛이 샌다: The giant sleeps face down upon that drawing. A faint blue light leaks from within its arms. In a thousand years it has not once shifted. For fear the drawing would be rubbed away.
이글루 안쪽 벽에 숯으로 쓴 글이 겹겹이다. 겨울마다 다른 사냥꾼이 썼다: The inner wall of the igloo is layered with writing in charcoal. A different hunter wrote each winter.
\"요른을 눈에 묻음. 다음 날 가 보니 없음. 파헤친 자국 아님. 눈을: "Buried Jorn in the snow. Went the next day and he was gone. Not dug up. The snow was swept aside to left and right. Footprints twice the height of a man."
\"시체 도둑. 흰 것. 덩치가 곰 셋. 죽은 것만 가져감. 사냥감에는: "Corpse thief. A white thing. Big as three bears. Takes only the dead. Doesn't touch the game. Leaves our food alone too."
\"그놈 굴 앞까지 쫓아감. 요른이 서 있었음. 얼어서. 똑바로. 눈 덮: "Tracked it to the mouth of its den. Jorn was standing there. Frozen. Upright. Under an overhang so the snow wouldn't cover him. Went there angry and couldn't be angry."
The newest writing, in a shaking hand: "Broke my leg in the blizzard. Thought I was done for. The white thing came and sniffed at me. A long time. Then it put me on its back. Woke up at the igloo door. Seems it doesn't take the ones still alive."
탐험대장 로란: …다닐로, 요나, 페이. 놈들이 누워 있던 자리를 나는: Captain Roran: …Danilo, Jonah, Fei. I never found where they lay. I thought it was because the snow had covered them. If someone carried them off before it could.
The hunters' igloo. A different one stays here every winter. Look at the wall.
The inner wall. Charcoal writing, layer on layer. This time we read to the end.
So it wasn't wolves. Let's go. The cave deep in the snowfield.
굴 벽을 따라 얼어붙은 사람들이 서 있다. 수십 구. 전부 굴 입구 쪽을: Frozen people stand along the cave wall. Dozens of them. All facing the mouth of the cave. Not one has fallen.
발밑마다 눈을 다져 받침을 만들었다. 큰 손으로 꾹꾹 누른 자국. 쓰러지: At every pair of feet the snow has been packed into a base. The marks of a big hand pressing it down. Those about to topple have been propped with pillars of ice.
줄 끝의 셋은 다른 것보다 덜 삭았다. 목에 같은 색 목도리. 조사대 것: The three at the end of the row are less decayed than the rest. Scarves of the same color at their necks. Survey Corps issue. One froze with a hand resting on another's shoulder.
탐험대장 로란: 다닐로다. 요나. 페이. …페이가 요나 어깨를 잡고 있군: Captain Roran: That's Danilo. Jonah. Fei. …Fei has hold of Jonah's shoulder. Must have been chattering to the very end.
…이 굴이다. 다닐로, 요나, 페이. 수첩에는 '눈보라, 셋 실종'이라고: …This is the cave. Danilo, Jonah, Fei. All I wrote in the notebook was 'blizzard, three missing.'
Look at the ones standing along the wall. Every one of them faces the entrance.
Not one has fallen over. Someone stood them up. One by one.
We found the three. They were standing. …Go on out first. I'll look a little longer.
굴 안쪽 벽의 그림: Drawings on the Inner Cave Wall
가장 안쪽 벽에 긁어 그린 그림이 있다. 사람 손이 그린 것과 큰 발톱이: Drawings are scratched into the innermost wall. Some made by human hands, some by great claws. The lower ones are human, the upper ones claw.
사람의 그림: 두꺼운 옷을 입은 이들이 죽은 이를 세운다. 발밑에 눈을: The human drawing: people in thick clothes stand a dead man upright. They pack snow at his feet. Beside them a small white beast sits watching. Words: "What is covered is forgotten. If they stand, those who pass will see. To see is to remember."
다음 그림: 짐승이 자랐다. 사람들과 같이 죽은 이를 나른다. 사람이 짐: The next drawing: the beast has grown. It carries the dead alongside the people. A person strokes the beast's head. Words: "Skor. The one who does not cover. When we are gone, you do it."
Above that there are only claw drawings. People stood upright. The row grows longer. To the end of the wall. No human hand appears in the drawings again.
맨 끝에 발톱으로 그린 것이 하나 다르다. 누운 사람 하나와, 그 옆에: At the very end, one claw drawing is different. One person lying down, and a great beast standing beside them. Several lines above the one lying down. A living person. The beast drew the day it learned that the living are not to be stood up.
스코르. 덮지 않는 자. …잊히지 않게 세워 두는 건, 제가 하는 일이랑: Skor. The one who does not cover. …Standing them up so they aren't forgotten. That's the same as the work I do.
스코르, 설원의 장의사\n눈에 덮이지 않게, 죽은 이들을 세워 둔 짐승:
Skor, undertaker of the snowfield
The beast that stood the dead upright so the snow would not cover them
얼음을 품은 거인 (프로스트모): The Giant That Holds the Ice (Frostmaw)
얼음을 품은 거인\n서리 왕국의 아이들이 맡긴 결정을 천 년 품고 잔 짐:
The giant that holds the ice
The beast that slept a thousand years holding the crystal the children of the Frost Kingdom left in its care
산 위의 옛 망루: The Old Watchtower on the Mountain
마당에 사람 키만 한 돌이 둥글게 서 있다. 돌마다 문장과 이름이 새겨져: Stones as tall as a person stand in a ring in the yard. Each is carved with a crest and a name. Flame, furnace, sand, cog, wave, silence, frost.
세어 보면 여덟이다. 여덟째 돌은 다른 돌과 똑같이 다듬어져 있다. 모서: Count them and there are eight. The eighth stone is dressed just like the others. Its edges, its base. A stone made with care. And yet its face is blank.
빈 면을 손으로 쓸어 보면 정 자국이 하나도 없다. 새겼다 지운 것이 아: Run a hand over the blank face and there is not one chisel mark. It was not carved and then erased. The mason finished cutting the stone, and forgot what was to be carved.
돌 밑동에 아주 작게 석공의 표시가 있다. 일곱 돌에는 '새김'. 여덟째: At the foot of each stone is the mason's mark, very small. On seven stones: 'carved.' On the eighth: 'waiting.'
탐험대장 로란: 하윤이 먼저 올랐다. 높은 데를 좋아했으니까. 오토는 밑: Captain Roran: Hayun went up first. She liked high places. Otto sang from below.
탐험대장 로란: 기둥이 꺼졌다. 오토는 노래를 멈추고 뛰어 올라갔다. 받: Captain Roran: The pillar gave way. Otto stopped singing and ran up. To catch her. The two fell together.
Captain Roran: …Don't say it in words. Come down and show me.
The seals are not seven but eight.
The eighth stone still waits for a name.
탑의 용 깃발: The Dragon Banners of the Tower
탑 벽마다 깃발이 걸려 있다. 불꽃 한 송이에 칼 하나. 호르스의 투구와: Banners hang on every wall of the tower. A single flame and a single sword. The same crest as on Hors's helmet. The Grand Master's own household.
깃발은 천 년 된 천이 아니다. 여러 번 새로 걸렸다. 탑을 지키는 해골: The banners are not thousand-year-old cloth. They have been hung anew many times. Whenever they rot, the skeleton guards who keep the tower weave them again and hang them. Standing watch even in death.
가장 낡은 깃발 귀퉁이에 수놓은 글: \"애쉬로드. 재의 주인이 아니라,: Words stitched in the corner of the oldest banner: "Ashlord. Not the master of ash, but the one who follows its master until it turns to ash." It is the dragon's name.
탑 꼭대기의 안장: The Saddle at the Top of the Tower
탑 꼭대기 받침 위에 안장이 놓여 있다. 사람이 탈 크기가 아니다. 가죽: A saddle rests on the plinth at the top of the tower. It is not sized for a person to ride. The leather is a thousand years old, yet there is no dust on it. No soot either.
안장 둘레 바닥만 유리처럼 녹아 반들거린다. 누군가 아주 뜨거운 숨으로,: Only the floor around the saddle has melted smooth like glass. Something has been burning the ground around it with a very hot breath, very carefully, sparing only the saddle. Every day.
The saddle straps have not been undone. They are cinched. Ready to be ridden at any moment.
탐험대장 로란: (지팡이를 짚고 한참 본다.) …나는 스무 해 동안 부두: Captain Roran: (He leans on his cane and looks for a long while.) …For twenty years I never cleared away the eleven empty bunks at the dock. It's the same thing.
That tower. They say there's one more who waits. I have to see it.
The banners on the wall. A single flame and a single sword. The crest from Hors's helmet.
On the plinth at the top. A saddle. …Not sized for a person.
There was no dust on the saddle. On leather a thousand years old. Let's go. We need to see the floor below, too.
아래층 벽감에 얇은 석판이 쌓여 있다. 당번이 바뀔 때마다 한 장씩 썼다: Thin stone tablets are stacked in a niche on the lower floor. One written at each change of the watch. The writing grows clumsier and clumsier. From the time they began writing with finger bones.
\"단장께서 아침마다 사과를 한 광주리 가져오심. 지상의 것. 용은 불을: "The Grand Master brings a basket of apples every morning. From the surface. The dragon drinks fire, but it eats apples on the side. The Grand Master says, 'This one has a sweet tooth, and that's the trouble.'"
\"단장께서 떠나심. 심지를 받으러. 용에게 '기다려라, 금방 온다' 하: "The Grand Master has left. To receive the wick. He told the dragon, 'Wait, I'll be right back.' He did not unstrap the saddle."
\"사과를 드려도 드시지 않음. 남쪽을 보심. 밤에 남쪽 하늘이 붉어지면: "It will not eat the apples we offer. It looks south. On nights when the southern sky turns red, it cries. A red night is a night the Grand Master is in pain. So we say among ourselves."
가장 새 석판: \"사과 광주리 비치함. 썩으면 새것으로 바꿈. 드시지: The newest tablet: "Basket of apples set out. Replaced when they rot. Replaced even if it does not eat. Because when the Grand Master returns, his first words will be, 'Did you give it its apples?'"
남쪽 창 아래 광주리가 놓여 있다. 안의 사과는 싱싱하다. 오늘 아침에: A basket sits beneath the south window. The apples in it are fresh. They were changed this morning. Who brings them, and from where, there is no telling.
광주리 둘레 바닥에 큰 발톱 자국이 반원으로 패여 있다. 창 쪽을 보고: Great claw marks are worn into the floor in a half circle around the basket. The place where it sits facing the window. In the same posture for a thousand years.
사과에는 이빨 자국이 없다. 단 하나만 빼고. 맨 위의 사과에 아주 조심: There are no tooth marks in the apples. Except for one. On the topmost apple there is a single, very careful mark. A bite begun and left off.
탐험대장 로란: …먹으면 주인이 안 오는 걸 인정하는 것 같았겠지. 그래: Captain Roran: …To eat would have felt like admitting its master isn't coming. So it didn't. But today it took one bite. When it heard us coming up. Thinking someone was coming.
The lower floor of the tower. The room of the ones who stand watch even in death.
Stone tablets stacked in the niche. A watch log. The writing gets clumsier as it goes.
Look at the basket under the south window. The apples are fresh. This morning's.
Now I know whose hand the beast is waiting for. Better to go knowing. Let's go.
문 앞의 기사, 서약 자리의 부단장, 탑의 용. 주군 하나에 기다리는 놈: The knight before the gate, the Vice Master at the place of the oath, the dragon in the tower. One lord, and three left waiting. …He left a great many behind.
그 아이를 재워 주었구나.\n…돌아가지 못한다고, 내 입으로 말해 줬어야:
So you put that child to sleep.
…I should have told it with my own mouth that I could not come back.
장로 에르윈: 사과였다고. …그래, 그 녀석은 단 걸 좋아했지. 빨간 것: Elder Erwin: Apples, you say. …Yes, that one did have a sweet tooth. Liked the green ones better than the red.
▷ The log didn't say anything about green apples.
장로 에르윈: (잠깐 멈춘다. 장갑을 고쳐 낀다.) …그런가. 그럼 다른: Elder Erwin: (He pauses a moment. Adjusts his glove.) …Did it not. Then I must have read it in another book. When you grow old, what you have read and what you have seen run together.
장로 에르윈: 아르덴이라는 사람은 말일세. 기록에 따르면, 뭐든 '금방: Elder Erwin: This Arden, you see. According to the records, he was a man who told everyone 'I'll be right back.' His squire, his Vice Master, his dragon. And he truly meant it. That was the man's greatest fault.
장로 에르윈: 심지를 몸에 가두는 일이 하루면 끝날 줄 알았던 걸세. 일: Elder Erwin: He thought that locking the wick inside his body would be done in a day. Because the seven kings told him so. 'You need only hold it a moment.'
▷ 일곱 왕이 속인 건가요?: ▷ Did the seven kings deceive him?
장로 에르윈: 속였다기보다… 떠넘긴 걸세. 불꽃의 왕은 제 몫을 제 기사: Elder Erwin: Not deceived so much as… passed it off. The King of Flame handed his share to his own knight. We will speak of that someday, when you see the seal for yourself. For today, just write down that dragon's name. For Isabel.
애쉬로드, 기사단장 아르덴의 용\n재가 될 때까지 따르는 자. 사과는 풋:
Ashlord, dragon of Grand Master Arden
The one who follows until it turns to ash. Prefers its apples green.
기둥에 걸린 가면들: The Masks Hung on the Pillar
숲 한가운데 기둥에 가면 수백 개가 걸려 있다. 전사들이 쓰는 것보다 훨: Hundreds of masks hang on the pillar at the heart of the grove. Far older than the ones the warriors wear. The colors have faded, and of some only half remains.
가면 안쪽마다 이름이 새겨져 있다. 얼굴 닿는 자리에. 쓰는 사람의 이름: A name is carved inside every mask. Where the face touches. Not the name of the wearer. The name of the person whose face it was.
부족은 죽은 이의 얼굴을 깎아 쓰고 다닌다. 누군가 그 얼굴로 걷는 동안: The tribe carves the faces of its dead and wears them. As long as someone walks with that face, they are not forgotten. The golden disc at the top of the pillar, the 'second sun,' shines on all the masks at once.
